[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/fe25d1240929213e1885be229e5a0f327ab15412.gif[/img]
[*] As a connected client, some players reported that Seeker’s Spirit Punch had a chance to collide twice with the enemy and deal double damage. That has now been addressed. 
[*] As a connected client, players reported that The False Son’s Boss fight would sometimes not show certain animations. He’s back to using those abilities properly. 
[*] Players reported that on a certain version of Aphelian Sanctuary, a mysterious floating tree would spawn. The tree has been returned to the ground where it belongs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/2d17ba4762777c8074d131974f8645b3413f546e.gif[/img]
[*] Players reported that the lightning on Prime Meridian would only ever target the Host in multiplayer sessions. The lightning will now attack everyone equally.
[*] Platforms for The False Son’s arena on Prime Meridian would sometimes not change for clients when moving between phases. They will now appear/disappear just as they would to the host. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/40bcd336d2992ff5588cc1bacebd0c36d0eb49fd.png[/img]
[*] Resolved a reported issue that led to players sometimes not properly spawning in when entering cross play sessions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/77fcc30a3480c81485b8dbeb733632f0716213ba.gif[/img]
[*] Players that use PlayStation controllers on PC reported to us that Xbox glyphs were being displayed instead. The correct glyphs will now be displayed. 
[*] As a connected client, players reported that sometimes The False Son’s large boss health bar would not reappear after changing phases. It will now show back up for all players. 
[*] Resolved a reported issue with the Prismatic Trial leaderboard not displaying any times. 
[*] Players have reported a mysterious Xi Construct creature appearing in the new Aphelian Bulwark Ambry Variant. That monster has now been removed from the monster pool.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3c2c02410feafeba6b011b22a89804a213216080.gif[/img]
[*] Addressed a reported issue where the affliction stacks that Tonic gave you would display a place-holder description. 
[*] Resolved an issue where - when fighting the False Son Boss with Artifact of Swarms - the Prime Meridian event achievement would unlock after only killing one of the bosses. 
[*] Players who attempted to join lobbies reported to us that sometimes it would just not allow them to join and not tell them why. An issue has been resolved that made certain error messages not appear when joining lobbies. The most common of those was not receiving a message when a crossplay-enabled user attempted to join one without crossplay enabled. 
[*] Resolved an issue that could sometimes trap players outside of The False Son’s boss room upon being resurrected by Seeker. 
[*] When playing as Mul-T and using the Sentry skin, sometimes players would not receive the visual effect when frozen. You are once again able to turn Mul-T into an ice cube.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28fcac94519e9e4ce660642a8f918b0f0f4e36bc.jpg[/img]
[*] Resolved an issue players reported where applying bleed with Noxious Thorns could make monsters turn on each other and ignore the player. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e616e151956bdae6bf4293814c9cad7bb9805335.gif[/img]
[*] Addressed another reported issue with Noxious Thorn where it would not correctly apply + 1 stack of another active debuff. It had sometimes only been applying its bleed stack. 
[*] Resolved an issue where using Sojourn, Eccentric Vase, or Volcanic Egg could lock you out of viewing the False Son fight into or teleporting up to the platform. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/128ed23f948f25cc076710473edc19d9741016a9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Seekers of the Storm - First Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Everyone,[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/df020718d40cf821555aab53126797dd951a4714.png[/img]
We want to start off by mentioning how much we appreciate folks jumping in and giving [i]Seekers of the Storm[/i] a swing – we’ve never had so many people playing [i]Risk of Rain 2[/i]. We also hear you loud and clear—this DLC fell short of your expectations. That feedback is fair. We’d like to take a moment and walk everyone through our plan to make it right. 

First, to be clear, we're committed to making the DLC everything that you expected and deserve. The team already jumped in and knocked out solutions for a BUNCH of the bugs some users are reporting. The full patch notes can be found below. Here are a few highlights: 
[list][*] Resolved a bug with the way builds are compiled that occasionally led to behaviors being erroneously tied to FPS. 
[*] Addressed an issue that some users reported with items not being picked up when interacted with.
[*] Mithrix will no longer become (nearly) invincible upon stealing a player’s Warped Echo. 
[/list]This is the first step. These patches will continue to roll out on a regular basis as we work on additional fixes. 

Beyond bugs, the team is also looking closely at your gameplay feedback. We want [i]Seekers of the Storm[/i] to be the best possible version of itself, and that involves listening to the community. While we’re focused on bugs for now, we’ll be looking to implement more of those gameplay updates in future patches. 

Lastly, we are going to post notes with the release of every patch, starting today. That way, it will be clearer which fixes are arriving. Sometimes, we’ll fix a bug that inadvertently changes something else, and we appreciate you continuing to share feedback when those issues arise. 

This is a game that countless people love; anything that jeopardizes that experience is something we take very seriously. We hope that in the coming days and weeks, we can earn back your trust, and we know that’s going to take time and action.

[b]Thanks for now, [/b]

[i]The Risk of Rain Team[/i] 

[h3]To Report Bugs:[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/df020718d40cf821555aab53126797dd951a4714.png[/img]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/riskofrain2]Discord[/url]
[url=https://support.gearboxsoftware.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001615171-Risk-of-Rain-2]Gearbox Support[/url]

[h3]Full Patch Notes for V1.3.2:
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/df020718d40cf821555aab53126797dd951a4714.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Resolved a bug with the way builds are compiled that led to many behaviors being erroneously tied to FPS. These elements included physics, attack speed, and movement. This was not the result of any significant architecture changes to the game. The bug that created this issue has been addressed. 
[*] Addressed an issue some players reported where Mithrix would become invincible upon stealing your Warped Echo.
[*] The Teleporter will no longer spawn inside geometry on Rallypoint Delta.  
[*] Acrid's Utility Skills, both Caustic Leap & Frenzied Leap were not dealing damage or colliding properly. Acrid should now be back in action.  
[*] Resolved an issue reported by some users with items not being picked up when interacted with. Despite not being picked up, some players would receive a large number of item stacks anyway. Both parts of this issue are now resolved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/cf90c9c615f73eca0b63048e5fda440480828785.gif[/img]
[*] Item highlights have now returned to various shops & adaptive chests. 
[*] You’ll now no longer be able to escape Shattered Abodes, at least in the ways we didn't intend.
[*] We've restored the full screen damage indicator and low health feedback.
[*] An issue that caused some players to get stuck while smelling the flowers on Reformed Altar has been resolved.
[*] Longstanding Solitude will no longer sometimes show pinged interactables at 2x cost.
[*] The portal will no longer spawn inside geometry in Bulwark’s Ambry. 
[*] Healthbars were updating very slowly. That has now been resolved. 
[*] Halcyonite's spawn animation was playing at lower than expected framerates. He won’t be jittery anymore when spawning in.
[*] We’ve resolved a bug with Seeker's Sojourn ability that sometimes blocked non-host players from using it. 
[*] Players are now able to pick up CHEF’s food drops from farther away. 
[*] We’ve rolled out a change to the Halcyon Beacon’s texture on Gilded Coast. The team is going to continue monitoring this one. There may be more changes coming on this front.
[*] Loader's Knuckleboom VFX has been realigned. 
[*] We’ve resolved an issue some players reported that Survivor VFX in the character select screen overlapped with the Ready button.
[*] Fixed an issue with Bolstering Lantern where the logbook ‘unlock’ highlighting no longer was clearing after viewing the unlock. 
[*] Solved an issue where the ‘item count’ displayed on the tab menu in multiplayer sessions would show 1 for some players despite not having any items. 
[*] Resolved an issue where Sojourn would sometimes fail to trigger when colliding with monsters or geometry. 
[*] Changed the visual effects of the initial jump pads on Meridian to convey better to players from a distance. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/48153b929191ea30a402b774fb6639ec14d19971.jpg[/img]
[*] Resolved an issue that led to the Imp Overlord’s Void Spike ability sometimes not dealing damage. 
[*] Addressed an issue reported by some players on Prime Meridian where lighting would spawn on top of players during the False Son cutscene. 
[*] Resolved an issue where the Scorch Worm would snap 90 degrees right before attacking. 
[*] Gaining multiple Warped Echos on Heretic led to infinite stacks of the item buff being added to the player. This has been resolved. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a28338eb1d45571edf7b5026431017add4aa2787.gif[/img]
[*] Sonorous Whispers had an issue where the drop chance of items could become extremely high, especially later into runs. This has been re-balanced to be more realistic. Elite item drop chance: 15% (+5% per stack) -> 4% (+1% per stack). Logbook change is still pending. 
[*] Solved an issue where the music would stop if a player opened the logbook and clicked on an item during a run. 
[*] Addressed an issue reported by some players where entering the Prime Meridian cutscene with >4 players resulted in a softlock. To make it clear, >4 player co-op is still not officially supported. We just wanted to address this anyway because we know many players still opt to unlock max lobby size with convars. 
[*] Teleporters should no longer be able to spawn within Halcyonite Shrines 
[*] Resolved an issue where some players without SOTS could become soft locked by not being able to interact with the Shrine of Rebirth upon defeating False Son.
[*] CHEF has had some item placements moved (where items are displayed on his character model when picked up) to avoid clipping with other items and parts of his model. 
[*] Addressed an issue with Railgunner’s Concussion Device (utility - mine) where it would not detonate on its own. It will now detonate after a few seconds like normal. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/cf184de809baf7e23b9644c93742ddaed09da9c4.gif[/img]
[*] Resolved an issue reported by some players where sometimes skills wouldn’t activate when pressed. This ended up being a bi-product of the FPS-related issues we outlined above. Both are now resolved. 
[*] Addressed a bug that allowed players to permanently fire False Son’s Laser of the Father ability (special – head laser). It will now go on cooldown after fired for up to 4 seconds. 
[*] Increased the intensity of the VFX for CHEF’s Dice ability (primary – cleaver). This should make it easier to spot when thrown a far distance out. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/5f1a13f2f6b9fba6a8b02986526ff65d693c9be4.jpg[/img]
[*] Addressed an issue where players would be unable to input actions for Seeker’s Meditate ability while having both mouse/keyboard and a controller plugged in at the same time. 
[*] Resolved an issue where sometimes Chef’s Dice (primary – cleavers) couldn’t be recalled while at either unlimited or under 30 FPS. That issue was part of the FPS-tied-mechanics issue above. Both have been solved. 
[*] Addressed an issue where Acrid was no longer able to hit enemies or spread his poison using Epidemic (special – poison blob attack) 
[*] Solved an issue where The Crowdfunder would stop firing if framerate fell under 30FPS. This was also part of the FPS-tied-mechanics issue above. Both issues have been resolved. 
[*] Acrid’s Frenzied Leap (utility – jump) now properly negates fall damage when falling from large heights. 
[*] Addressed an issue where standing behind Mithrix, while entering phase 4, results in him losing aggression towards you temporarily. 
[*] Parents had an issue where they would attempt to navigate to the player but get stuck on a navigation node, that issue has now been fixed. We are tracking broadly similar behavior with some other monsters, but none were nearly as severe as Parents were. 
[*] We are aware of False Son's downward plunge attack not behaving as intended. We're currently working to address this issue, but did not want it to hinder the release of additional changes. 
[/list]

notes.title: Seekers of the Storm Dev Diary #5 - Post-Launch Progress Report
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,
[/h3]Over the past few days we’ve been reviewing feedback surrounding the launch of Risk of Rain 2: Seekers of the Storm. Thank you as always to the incredible community of players who have come out to support us and provide insights which are helping to resolve some unexpected issues with the deployment of the latest DLC. 
[h3]We’re working on a PC patch
[/h3]First, we want to share our plan for how we're addressing these concerns. We’ve been able to reproduce many of the bugs you’ve brought to our attention. We’re working as swiftly as possible to get fixes delivered to you. These will be shipped on PC first with consoles to follow as quickly as we can. 
While this patch won't solve every issue you’re running into, we’re prioritizing the community reported issues as best we can. Please continue to submit bug reports on Discord, with video if possible. Reach out to our customer support team if you need help.
[h3]With that, here's the initial list of bugs we're targeting for a PC patch. Keep an eye out for more info![/h3][list]
[*] Many elements of the game are affected by a bug that leads to their behaviors changing depending on a player’s FPS. These elements included physics, attack speed, and movement. This issue has a planned fix with the upcoming patch.
[*] Final bosses are meant to be difficult, but Mithrix becoming invincible when stealing your Warped Echo or Chronic Expansion was definitely not intentional. We plan to fix this issue.
[*] We plan to fix Item highlights failing in various shops & adaptive chests.
[*] With a planned change you’ll no longer be able to escape Shattered Abodes, at least in the ways we didn't intend, in the next patch.
[*] We plan to restore the visual indicators of taking damage on HUDs.
[*] An issue that allowed players to get stuck while smelling the flowers on Reformed Altar has a planned fix.
[*] We plan to fix an issue where Longstanding Solitude would sometimes show pinged interactables at 2x cost. 
[*] We plan to fix an issue with the Teleporter spawning inside geometry on Rallypoint Delta.
[*] Acrid's Utility Skills, both Caustic Leap & Frenzied Leap were not dealing damage properly. Acrid should be fully back in action with the next patch.
[*] We plan to fix an issue with a portal spawning inside geometry in Bulwark’s Ambry.
[*] We plan to fix healthbars being slow to update.
[*] We plan to fix the low framerate in Halcyonite's spawn animation.
[*] We plan to fix an issue where Seeker's Sojourn ability would not work for non-host players in a multiplayer game.    
[*] We plan to extend the pickup radius on Chef's food.
[*] We plan to fix a visual issue with Halcyon Beacon’s texture upon activation on Gilded Coast.
[*] We plan to realign Loader's Knuckleboom VFX.
[*] We plan to fix an issue where Survivor VFX in the character select screen overlapped with the Ready button.
[/list][h3]Regional pricing adjusted on Steam
[/h3]We've worked with our partners at Steam to adjust the pricing of Seekers of the Storm in select markets. The new pricing more closely matches prices from Survivors of the Void. This change is already in effect. Those who have already purchased the content should request a refund through Steam and repurchase at the updated price once they see it has been adjusted.

We deeply appreciate your feedback and support. As soon as we have more info we’ll make sure everyone gets another update.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306620/

[previewyoutube=t0pNbrHzS4A;full][/previewyoutube]

Welcome back to another Dev Diary! Today we’re serving up something special. But before we dive into the main course, let’s cover some exciting news.

First off, we’re thrilled to announce that Seekers of the Storm is launching on August 27th! That’s right, the wait is almost over, and the team’s excited for everyone to hop in. We'd also like to reveal that Seekers of the Storm will be priced at $14.99! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a4dbce9425a67aa344b766423c36fc76b4284615.gif[/img]

Now onto our final appetizer; alongside the expansion, we’re making our official debut on Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5. For a long time now, folks have been able to play the existing PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions on their next gen consoles. But now they’ll have the real deal. All new and existing players will be upgraded at no additional cost! And that upgrade isn’t just a sprinkling of performance optimization—oh no—it brings split-screen couch co-op and a handful of fun, platform-specific features. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/481f43961b1f7c76f7c02a9b93a1d24e62bf32b0.gif[/img]

[h2]Now, onto the main dish—Meet Chef: The Connoisseur of Culinary Carnage!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3641f15c616371d846718465d19f62a27b98d799.gif[/img]

This isn’t your grandpa’s Chef bot. Years  of battling some of the most monstrous ingredients on Petrichor V have hard boiled his soul. 

You’ll need to cook up something truly delicious to unlock Chef! So, get ready to sauté your way through hordes, blend your combat skills with culinary precision, and serve up some justice… à la mode.

[h2]Let’s take a look at Chef’s Primary Skill: Dice
[/h2]

Those years of primal culinary misadventures have trained Chef to have incredible control over his trusty cleavers. Hurl them at faraway enemies and call them back to slice and dice with twice the pain. Monsters hit on the return journey will take an additional chunk of damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/b6e54247851bd006517040af23acfc3547b9cf8f.gif[/img]

This also effectively doubles your chance of triggering   your on-hit items, ahh looks like he’s stocking up for his next set of customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/487af8fdeb83aef401be0a627a0eea6e52dee61f.gif[/img]

[h2]Next on the menu is Chef’s Secondary Skill: Sear
[/h2]

Oh god, I knew I forgot to turn the oven off. Well, we might as well make the best of it. Nothing ruins a monster’s day quite like being flambéed. Sear allows Chef to inflict a huge amount of damage, and apply burn, at a very short range. Customers trapped in this skill will quickly accrue copious stacks of burn. If you’re getting swarmed by some unwanted vermin, this is a great way to clear your path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/66f9306f9a7e54f994c89e6b483028a6eb2a52ca.gif[/img]

[h2]If it’s time to hurl yourself into the fray, activate Chef’s Utility Skill: Roll
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/4e263772b71d8d941469d228b16b62082543bdfc.gif[/img]
The long legs of past Chefs have been swapped with a huge roller—perfect for flattening out a nice, tidy pie crust...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/d4cfe6f1fe32a07333bb1ef30097ee8797cb5efa.gif[/img]

...or steamrolling whatever helpless Lemurians were unfortunate enough to wake up this morning.

This skill’s wind up makes you a bit vulnerable for a moment. But the longer you spool, the more damage you do and the faster you’ll go.

[h2]But wait a second… how are we supposed to sauté without any oil. Chef’s Special Skill Glaze can help us out with that. [/h2]

This skill allows Chef to hurl large globs of oil towards his waiting customers. Leverage sear after you’ve sufficiently coated an enemy to unleash radically more damage. Looking around while launching Glaze can cover a far larger area with oil. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/277f4e798dd35b53e32fefce8c1c710c7a3af230.gif[/img]

Or you can just run up the tab on one customer... That poor beetle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/87c15bc6c5fe70a937b7f1c657befb1db4523e29.gif[/img]

Wait a second, something magical happened when we properly sautéd one of our customers...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/f1514a5e8f1ea2ddaca3f24b184748978c762bce.gif[/img]

[h2]...Ahh, that takes us to Chef’s passive skill: Chef’s Kiss
[/h2]

This skill helps tie the whole meal together. If you prepare your customers   with two or more skills before finishing them off, they’ll turn into a delightful treat. The healing from these can really help you out in a pinch.   Glaze up a horde, then unleash a well-timed sear, and you’ll find yourself in a pile of nourishing snacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e448476337adf01b3d4b195577ae78027455146a.gif[/img]

[h2]For dessert, we have one for the purists. Here’s a sneak peek at Chef’s alternate Special Skill: Yes, Chef!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/18cd79825caa2985988cd7cd3d13d0c0dbedb342.gif[/img]

This skill will remind you of the Chefs of yore. Activating it will empower your next ability. We won’t go into the particulars of exactly how each skill is empowered, but the discerning sommeliers among you can get a hint at some of them in Chef’s Survivor Showcase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/46f4534becc8147917898957d0b7db227ad38996.gif[/img]

[h2]And that’s a wrap on our final dev diary for Seekers of the Storm! 
[/h2]
With Chef in your corner, the battlefield is your kitchen, and every enemy is just another ingredient waiting to be chopped, seared, and rolled. We’re thrilled to see how you’ll mix up your gameplay with this new take on our beloved Chef.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/d4f91b1e134e17f2ca04aaed7a72789a4e415ad1.gif[/img]

The team has been working on Seekers of the Storm for a while now. Words can’t express how excited we are for everyone to hop in on August 27th. For now, head over and Wishlist it today. This is Bruno, signing off.

[h2]Wishlist the [i]Seekers of the Storm[/i] Expansion Here:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306620/

notes.title: SOTS Dev Diary #3 - First Survivor Reveal!
notes.content:
[h3]Wishlist the [i]Seekers of the Storm[/i] Expansion Here:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306620/

[h3]Video Dev Diary Version:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=GZf_zjqbPlc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone! I'm Bruno and today I'll be showing off one of the new Survivors arriving with [i]Seekers of the Storm[/i]! It’s been a while since our last Dev Diary, and I think we’ve got an exciting one for you. But first, I have a few questions...

Have you ever dreamed of punching monsters from 20 feet away?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3f340524a333eacbed10cdff81253211f673a141.gif[/img]

Do you have a friend who’s constantly being trampled by Bison before reaching the teleporter?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a39775b1d9193bc5499c9530b33158d288593eea.gif[/img]

Well, we may just have the answer to both of those.

[h2]Meet Seeker: An Enlightened Mid-Range Brawler [/h2]
Seeking paradise for her people, she was sent to scout Petrichor V. But instead, she quickly stumbled upon roots containing a mystical gold power. Through those channels, she managed to commune with a powerful forgotten creature. Her connection grew, and with it, her ability to unravel the secrets of soul manipulation. Now she can open gates that bring forth a new unbridled power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/121a22f7cea9798c5d86fba43c077303f1a15230.gif[/img]

Through this power, she can dish out incredible damage to nearby monsters, but uniquely, she’s also able to unleash potent healing abilities to sustain her teammates. This combination of brawling and healing is core to who Seeker is as a survivor. Players who learn how to seamlessly flow between them will be rewarded with one of the most versatile Survivors to ever grace a drop pod. 

[h2]Seeker’s Special Skill: Meditate[/h2]
Today, we’re gonna skip right to dessert and talk about Seeker’s special skill: Meditate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/8e35d01d8f01ef87846c19c94f4c15196868b497.gif[/img]

This ability challenges you to execute a timed sequence. Success with that sequence will cause a blast to emanate a short distance out from Seeker. Enemies in this range take a huge chunk of damage, and allies will receive a very handy heal.  

When playing with Seeker on your team, keep an eye out for when she starts to channel Meditate so you can swoop in and take advantage of some much-needed healing.  

But wait, there’s more!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/d918d7625a3c0df593ce425ae76bd9a543396f12.gif[/img]

On top of the blast effect from using her Meditate ability, Seeker will also gain a stack of Tranquility. Gathering a handful of Tranquility stacks will make certain abilities more potent. Upon completing your 7th stack, Seeker’s Meditate is even able to resurrect her fallen comrades.  

It’s alright, Commando, those Bison get the best of all of us sometimes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/bac7883e547493b956a4c869e7c7ccd167d94093.gif[/img]

[h2]Seeker’s Primary Skill: Spirit Punch[/h2]
Now let’s jump back and take a look at her primary skill: Spirit Punch. This ability is really a three-punch combo. Your first two punches fly rapidly forward, piercing through any monsters they hit. Every third punch will instead explode with increased damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/1c1b3dc471e1bfb45b3b3958dee8b25d548d2466.gif[/img]

Those Tranquility stacks from before also come in handy here. With each stack, your empowered explosive attack will grow more potent.  

In your head, it’s useful to map out your attacks so the third punch can claim a large clump of monsters. Do this right, and you’ll see why Seeker is one of the strongest AOE bruisers out there.

[h2]Seeker’s Secondary Skill: Unseen Hand[/h2]
Seeker’s secondary skill is Unseen Hand. Use it to unleash a giant phantasmal hand from the ground that slows, knocks back, and drains health from all that are in its range. One of Seeker's biggest drawbacks is her lack of long-range damage. You’ll often run into situations where a monster out-ranges your Spirit Punch.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/dee9629fb1ec8baddc3d6c7900c4cd5e0d46dee7.gif[/img]

Unseen Hand can help a bit with this. Its extreme long range means that in a pinch, you can use it to pick off monsters at a distance. But, unless your run is going particularly well, you’ll likely still need to close with your target before you’re able to finish them off.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/16472e47861635294fde99c332f9170ca4ed8f2f.gif[/img]

[h2]Seeker’s Utility Skill: Sojourn[/h2]
That’s where our next skill comes into play: Sojourn. This ability doesn't have a ‘normal’ skill duration. Instead, after three seconds of flight, it will start ticking down your health. To cancel your flight, either reactivate it or collide with something. Seeker will then explode, dealing damage and stunning your enemies.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a8b6dc726e774f4cd0a256e33f4a6f66bc77af44.gif[/img]

Range-finding exactly how much flight time you’re comfortable with can be a bit of a challenge. I’d avoid flinging yourself into a horde of enemies after you just took a lengthy Sojourn.   

Once your healing starts to take off, it becomes a lot less of an issue, but it’s worth being careful in the early stages. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/981b1ac9d0818512ab21fa27ea82b7f3cf7ede79.gif[/img]

[h2]And That’s a Wrap on Today's Dev Diary![/h2]
Seeker brings a unique blend of support and damage to Risk of Rain 2. Her ability to manipulate the essence of soul and empower allies makes her an invaluable asset.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e96a377a3ef158cc8332c3d138369ff8ef12f024.gif[/img]

We hope you loved getting a sneak peek at Seeker as much as we loved making her.  

If you look closely, you can also get a glimpse of an alternate ability in the trailer. But we’re gonna leave the details of that one a mystery for now. We can’t give out all her secrets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e579ee0f3d9cc739f44e42513b273200b33b0cad.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the launch of Seekers of the Storm. Don’t forget to jump over and wishlist it today; it really means a lot to the team. Thanks for listening, this is Bruno signing off. 

[h2]Wishlist the [i]Seekers of the Storm[/i] Expansion Here:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306620/

notes.title: The Devotion Update - Risk of Rain 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/4893aec4159bc392028bb06772f65842f281e86d.png[/img]

Version 1.10

Hello everyone! We're thrilled to unveil the latest addition to [i]Risk of Rain 2: The Devotion[/i] Update! Packed with an array of exciting content, this free update addresses various item and map bugs across both the base game and the [i]Survivors of the Void[/i] expansion. It also includes a super awesome collaboration…..

This update serves as a heartfelt token of appreciation to all who have contributed to making [i]Risk of Rain 2[/i] the phenomenal game it is today.

Let’s get into it!

[h1]New Content[/h1]

[b]Artifact of Delusion[/b]

Artifact of Delusion resets all chests once the teleporter event is finished and provides players the chance to receive additional items if they interact with the reset chests.
Whenever Players buy a chest before the teleporter event, the chest will remember what pickup was generated from it. After the teleporter event is finished Players can interact with chests that were previously bought (and have been reset). When the player interacts with the chest a small window will open up with three pickup options to choose from - one being the correct pickup generated from the chest, and two fake options will be mimicked from the Player's inventory. If the Player selects the pickup option that was originally generated from the chest, the Player will be given that item as a reward, making it so the Player has gained two items from that chest. If the Player selects the wrong pickup option, they will lose the item selected.

[b]Artifact of Devotion[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/517741f5417e09f0eade7870dcd2c1d206667f7f.gif[/img]

Replaces drones with interactive eggs that spawn Lemurian companions.

When interacting with an egg, a prompt pops up requiring a sacrifice of one item to spawn a Lemurian companion. The sacrificed item is given and applied to the recently spawned Lemurian. If multiple Lemurians are present in the party, items are shared between all Lemurians. Every teleport event survived by Lemurian companions triggers an evolution that gives them new attributes, makes them grow stronger, and gives an additional stack of the item they started with.

Devoted Lemurians start out with damage and health buffs equal to that of a normal elite to help them stay alive as well as scale according to the difficulty timer as other monsters. Each time a Lemurian evolves, they gain another stack of damage and defense buff to help their survival rate and incentivize players to stay ahead of the difficulty curve.

When Lemurians die, they drop a scrap of the same tier of item that they were given and their item is removed from the item pool.


[b]New map: Verdant Falls[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/096e896957cc00c0349f4a653874377ab0b643d8.gif[/img]

Verdant Falls is one of the lost regions players can explore in this new update. It’s a stunning map with a lush environment and allows players a lot of room to explore. We dive into more detail regarding this map and the other six maps coming to Seekers of the Storm in the Dev Diary [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/632360/announcements/detail/4212628592036521945?snr=2___]here[/url].


[b]Crossover event with Dead Cells [/b]

A lot of you had the chance to play some Risk of Rain inspired content in Dead Cells a year ago so we decided it’s time to return the favor. Starting today a very special Mercenary skin has arrived in Risk of Rain 2 for all players. Drop in and take a look at it today. We think it will remind you of someone 

[b]Minor Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Forgive Me Please equipment no longer triggers on kill effect continuously
[*] Artifact of Command no longer prevents Lunar Coins from spawning
[*] Chest, Firework and Squid Turret exploit fixed
[*] Demons and Crabs challenge unlocks normally
[/list]

As ever - thank you to everyone who has given us feedback and reported bugs since the launch of the expansion, we appreciate each and every one of you! To keep up to date with any further updates please follow us on Twitter or join our Discord.

Until next time!

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=SD6OqI1On4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

Thank you so much to everyone who tuned in today to watch The Festival of Gup and help celebrate the past 10 years of [i]Risk of Rain[/i]! We also hope you’ve enjoyed seeing some of our future plans for the franchise.

Missed the event? No worries! We have a recap for ya right here so you can see all the awesome things going on for [i]Risk of Rain[/i]!


[h2]Risk of Rain 2: Seekers of the Storm[/h2]

[previewyoutube=yLrpnBe1NDc;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Seekers of the Storm[/i] is the second expansion for [i]Risk of Rain 2[/i]! This expansion is LOADED with tons of content, new survivors, maps, monsters, and more! It also debuts our first stage with day-and-night versions! Those impact gameplay and grant access to new areas within the stage. 

[previewyoutube=l7Ffh8jEpL8;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned for more details about this expansion, but while you wait you can check out the first Dev Diary where you'll hear from our Loremaster Kayla Larson, Associate Art Lead Claire Bian, and Managing Director of Production James Lopez.  They will give you a first look at the mysterious False Son.

[b][i]You can wishlist that over here: [/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306620/Risk_of_Rain_2_Seekers_of_the_Storm/

[h2]Risk of Rain Returns[/h2]

[previewyoutube=F7jgwuE86Q0;full][/previewyoutube]

Starting TODAY you can challenge yourself by diving into progressively stronger runs! With additional Survivors, stages, items, mechanics, and a remastered soundtrack, Risk of Rain: Returns is loaded with new ways to play, so no two runs will ever be the same.

Act fast because for a short period [i]Risk of Rain: Returns[/i] will have a 15% discount to celebrate its launch!

[b][i]Drop into Risk of Rain Returns today: [/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337520/Risk_of_Rain_Returns/

[h2]Risk of Rain: Hostile Worlds[/h2]

[previewyoutube=Vp864T-6res;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Risk of Rain[/i] will be making its debut on mobile with [i]Risk of Rain: Hostile Worlds[/i]! 

Developed by Frima Studio, [i]Risk of Rain: Hostile Worlds[/i] brings the franchise to life for the first time ever on mobile featuring Risk of Rain's signature fast-paced action that merges the excitement of bullet hell roguelikes and action RPGs with hero collecting. 

This latest addition to the [i]Risk of Rain[/i] canon brings a beloved universe to mobile devices, enabling players to take their favorite franchise on the go.

[i]Risk of Rain: Hostile Worlds[/i] will be available on iOS and Android. Sign up today for our mailing list and join our social channels to stay informed!

This expansion features two Survivors—the skillful markswoman Railgunner, and the eldritch monstrosity Void Fiend—and the endless Simulacrum game mode, as well as new items, stages, and more.

notes.title: Risk of Rain 2 - PC Patch 7.5
Dev Thoughts 32 - Announcing Festival of Gup & The Last Survivor Coming to RORR
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2LfsYltzCxg;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi everyone! No lengthy intros today - let's get straight into it!

[h3]Festival of Gup[/h3]

The release of Risk of Rain Returns will not be the only way we're celebrating 10 years of the franchise - we will be taking a walk down memory lane and looking back at what got us here - and our friends at Gearbox will also be talking about [b]what’s ahead![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/6eb0987e741dccef08676d8b457a54952ba15d33.png[/img]

This 10th anniversary Showcase will be a celebration of the Risk of Rain community, and the big lovable orange blob - If you are a fan of Risk of Rain, or blobs, this is not to be missed so make sure you're following Gearbox on Twitch!

[url=www.twitch.tv/GearboxOfficial]www.twitch.tv/GearboxOfficial[/url]

[spoiler]Risk of Rain 2 fans do not want to miss this showcase...[/spoiler] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]

[h3]Risk of Rain Returns Release Details[/h3]

[b]Risk of Rain Returns will release on Steam and Nintendo Switch on November 8th 2023 - the exact 10 year anniversary of the release of the original Risk of Rain![/b]

The suggested retail price of Risk of Rain Returns will be $14.99 [b]however for a short period at launch there will be a -15% discount down to just $12.75[/b]

All of us at Hopoo Games want to take this opportunity to say a huge [b]thank you[/b] for both following along during the development of Risk of Rain Returns and all the support you’ve given us over the last ten years. It’s been a wild ride and we have plenty of plans for the future…

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337520/Risk_of_Rain_Returns/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]


For today, let's take a look at the final new Survivor joining the roster for [b]Risk of Rain Returns[/b].


[h3]Pilot[/h3]

Revealed in the intro cinematic, the Pilot of the Contact Light is joining the survivor roster for Risk of Rain Returns - bringing with him a highly mobile and context-sensitive playstyle unlike any other survivor in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/545e3ef90f65770c05c92095e0f0d31764600748.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

The workhorse of Pilot’s kit is his standard attack [b]Clusterfire[/b] - a triple burst shot where the third shot pierces enemies.

Great for damaging groups of enemies to set them up for your other abilities or to finish them off once you’ve already rained damage upon them from the skies..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/a1a72de4704fc55b2f88d583d9682927a144af7c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

…speaking of which the key to success when playing as Pilot is mastery of his utility ability - [b]Rapid Deployment. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/3d3f35729d7a0f0b50f5c75d02d12046e161ca34.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

Launch into the air and deploy your parachute to glide while unleashing your full arsenal of weapons on the enemies below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/561e5d49643f6d3cc1fab28c9a7f9c731a355dd6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

Your secondary attack [b]Target Acquired[/b] is a diagonal blast dependent on your current airborne status. If you’re in the air it will auto target on the enemies diagonally below you. If you’re on the ground it will auto target airborne enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/ef7040db552ddc654d0504ab52c6b1878103fb27.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

Don’t worry about there not being as many flying enemies in the game - your special ability [b]Airstrike[/b] can solve that particular problem.

Dropped below you if airborne - or placed at your feet with a backwards dash if you’re grounded - the [b]Airstrike[/b] hits multiple times both damaging enemies and launching them into the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/8dde5a6ae4b3a1e968c03e65dd3aa33406dc73d6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

This gives you the perfect chance to juggle them with Target Acquired and finish them off with Clusterfire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/34f16d1ca4bf5d5a13085d9d6f14be3b2ae2c1d0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

As with all the other survivors Pilot has three alternate abilities to unlock and discover when the game is released on November 8th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/3e2f7ea410050ea91ea41617401113ad71ee32d5.png[/img]

Check out the [url=https://youtu.be/pT1NOptB2gg?si=xaNUO7Ykl0ULNtcq]video Dev Thoughts[/url] above for an extended gameplay clip of Pilot in action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]

[h3]Risk of Rain Returns OST Vinyl Pre-Order[/h3]

As you’re hopefully aware by now not only has Chris Christodoulou returned with some special guests to produce some new music for Risk of Rain Returns, he has also remastered the original tracks to perfection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/78ba8a90a2c5fd3c25adf5ff186da0e2ca848ebe.png[/img]

Chris will be releasing a 4-Vinyl set including some great bonus content (contained on a Ukulele-shaped USB stick!) early next year but those pre-orders usually sell out quick so make sure if you want one, you grab one ASAP - [b]the pre-order is available right now![/b]

https://blackscreenrecords.com/products/risk-of-rain-returns


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]

[h3]And That’s Not All[/h3]

One last bit of news - for all you [i][b]*very patient*[/b][/i] console fans out there I am also very happy to announce that the Risk of Rain 2 Expansion: Survivors of the Void [b]will be arriving on Xbox One, Playstation 4 and Nintendo Switch on… you guessed it…. The 8th of November! [/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]

[b]We’re all very excited for you to finally get your hands on Risk of Rain Returns and we really want to know what you think! [/b]The best way to give us feedback is by joining the Risk of Rain Discord where we will be opening a Returns-specific feedback channel - and we’ll also have channels for you to find groups for multiplayer along with dozens of voice channels to use.

[url=https://discord.gg/riskofrain2]https://discord.gg/riskofrain2[/url]

The whole Hopoo Games team will be there and we’ll be eagerly reading all your feedback, so please join us for the release of Risk of Rain Returns on [b]November 8th![/b]

Cya then!

Jonathan
Hopoo Games
Community Manager

notes.title: Dev Thoughts 31 - Risk of Rain Returns
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=IFPmhhIov_k;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey!

Thanks again for joining us for the Dev Thoughts, today we're going to take a look at a brand new survivor for Risk of Rain Returns and talking to Hopoo Games composer Chris Christodoulou about the soundtrack. 

The majority of this content, along with the great new survivor trailer, are contained in the video version of the Dev Thoughts linked above, so make sure you watch it so you don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337520/Risk_of_Rain_Returns/

For the words-n-gifs fans among us, let's get acquainted with Risk of Rain's newest survivor...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]

[h3]Drifter[/h3]

The first brand new survivor debuting in [b]Risk of Rain Returns[/b] is [b]Drifter[/b]. This [i]resourceful brawler[/i] got more than she bargained for when she stowed away on the ill-fated Contact Light - luckily she has some unique skills to not only handle the dangerous inhabitants of Petrichor V but she also has some powerful tools to empower herself and her fellow Survivors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/92283e255b5cdffd5d7990bef424f2befb2dafe5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

Key to [b]Drifter’s[/b] power is her ability to utilise Scrap generated by her primary ability [b]Blunt Force[/b]. This may appear as useless rubbish to the other survivors - but to [b]Drifter[/b] it’s a valuable resource. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/41a1aad3565058a320969a768b4c735bf041ffd4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

[b]Blunt Force[/b] is a 3 hit combo melee attack that hits enemies in a wide area - each successful hit generates lumps of Scrap which litter the floor near Drifter - gather these quickly to fuel your more powerful abilities.

[b]Blunt Force[/b] isn't the only way to generate Scrap - [b]Drifter’s[/b] Utility ability [b]Suffocate[/b] also fills your meter without having to collect Scrap from the environment - This large melee strike stuns and does 200% damage - any enemy below 20% health when attacked with [b]Suffocate[/b] is immediately consumed and converted to Scrap. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/9040fc946c3654827daa8ea4d9ef043ee6ee8b6f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

Once you have gathered Scrap you have everything you need to fuel [b]Drifter’s[/b] other two abilities - including her secondary attack [b]Cleanup[/b]. This ability tosses out some of your Scrap as piercing projectiles in a short-range burst - imagine a trash powered shotgun that makes mincemeat of even the toughest enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/d6c84e0b12da61e7a58cd927d3357c03d082f99d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

Finally her special ability makes her a true powerhouse on the battlefield - not only to herself but her allies - when your Scrap meter is 75% full you gain access to [b]Salvage.[/b]

[b]Salvage[/b] allows [b]Drifter[/b] to generate 4 temporary items - these can then be collected by any player making her the survivor with the strongest support abilities in Risk of Rain. Have your teammates not been as fortunate as you when rolling the dice at chance shrines? Create some temporary items to share among your team before facing the tough challenges that await you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/f51177ede9ecb333ad7006af72ff330e918768da.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

[b]Of course there is nothing stopping you from just taking all the items for yourself and becoming the most powerful Survivor on the planet[/b] - key to success as [b]Drifter[/b] is to keep churning out temporary items as quickly as you can - they only last a short time in your inventory so continuing to replace them as they expire will maintain your strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/fbe50fb45d0b5915644b7700ece00bf4ab5a08cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/70251db3dd7da24ca8c72ea737ce5aa794f35395.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/39216fd2f36577670bb7ba84aa4aa7dbd32851e7.png[/img]

Like all the other survivors, [b]Drifter[/b] has a trio of alternate abilities to unlock, but I won't spoil those for you today, you can discover them yourself when Risk of Rain Returns is released later this year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/828d39c8f8f4173994e1424b01bc3eb977d13ef7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]

[h3]Chris Chrisodoulou Interview[/h3]

I interviewed Hopoo Games composer [b]Chris Christodoulou[/b] about his approach to the Risk of Rain Returns soundtrack - what changes he has made to the original OST, the approach he has taken to the new tracks coming in the game and much much more! .... You still here? Expecting some more words-n-gifs of a [i]video interview??[/i] Go watch the video Dev Thoughts linked at the top of the page! The interview is there!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/5466bc771b83106b1cb5df29495f5e61a72825ae.png[/img]

Thanks again everyone for your continued support, all of us at Hopoo Games are very excited for you to play Risk of Rain Returns soon! In the meantime don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/riskofrain2]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/hopoogames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/hopoo_games]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/spacegame2012]Youtube[/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@hopoo_games]TikTok[/url] to keep up to date with the latest on the game - next time we’ll be taking a look at the final new character dropping into Risk of Rain Returns…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364521/038bd1f0dd63b3615a2d2f6db903dfb00bce5b03.gif[/img]

Cya then!

Jonathan
Hopoo Games
Community Manager

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #28 - Risk of Rain Returns
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/9059f5ccbadfc5c58a7430c78ca23b283bf6d756.png[/img]

Hello and welcome once again to the Hopoo games Dev Thoughts! 

[previewyoutube=PivWxDUHlhw;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm Jonathan the Hopoo Games community manager and it's my pleasure to introduce you to our latest game:

[b]Risk of Rain Returns. [/b]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337520/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337520/[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Risk of Rain Returns[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/21d4a4d452cbcdc82a1925955f5a1b0843fe7ced.png[/img]

[b]Risk of Rain Returns[/b] is a remake of our original 2013 release Risk of Rain. For those of you unfamiliar with the original, [b]Risk of Rain Returns[/b] is a 2d multiplayer action platformer with roguelike elements. Stranded on a strange planet waves of alien monsters randomly spawn and attack you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/36af1a1a8e6eced87f9708ed056adb9d96a4610a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a431d3d5a1f55965948d0979e10d780366d1cad2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/21383b4b1c06c11cd5c414cb2b8004ea9e91cfd2.png[/img]

The strength of these enemies increases in difficulty as time passes so you have to balance between grabbing items to increase your power and racing through the multiple stages as fast as you can to stay ahead of the curve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/36af1a1a8e6eced87f9708ed056adb9d96a4610a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6a0f8746d89d7da0b2a13864a6c4a011dc1211d6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/21383b4b1c06c11cd5c414cb2b8004ea9e91cfd2.png[/img]

For those of you who [i]are[/i] familiar with Risk of Rain - don’t think this is just a lick of paint on an old classic - [b]Risk of Rain Returns completely overhauls the original and introduces a ton of new content. [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Updated Codebase[/b] - We'll be able to continue to update and add to the game with features that weren't previously possible
[*] [b]All Risk of Rain 1 content returning with glorious new HD pixel art[/b]
[*] [b]Enhanced Audio[/b] - including updated SFX & Chris Christodoulou is returning for some additional music tracks!
[*] [b]Countless rebalancing and gameplay tweaks[/b] - a smoother “gameplay feel” without losing that legendary Risk of Rain challenge
[*] [b]New Survivors[/b] - more on these in a future Dev Thoughts!
[*] [b]New Survivor Abilities[/b] - every character now has unlockable alternate abilities to customise your build! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/2aece4e180f8ab00eb98203c38f1e06afa3aa571.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New Items[/b] - some returning from RoR2, some entirely new! 
[*] [b]New Enemies[/b]
[*] [b]New Interactables[/b]
[*] [b]New Stage Variants[/b] - even RoR1 veterans will have to explore again!
[*] [b]Revamped Multiplayer[/b] - PC version is fully integrated into Steam - no more messing with router settings!!! 
[/list]

…and a huge amount more - [b]Risk of Rain Returns[/b] is a whole new game and an upgraded experience from the original Risk of Rain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/36af1a1a8e6eced87f9708ed056adb9d96a4610a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/5a284afef6a2ae16322f93c39aa871fa2a8a19b5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/21383b4b1c06c11cd5c414cb2b8004ea9e91cfd2.png[/img]

Between now and the to-be-announced release date I'll be doing regular Dev Thoughts updates to tell you more about our latest title, but before we go onto today's info I have some more great news to share.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Gearbox Acquisition of the Risk of Rain IP[/h3]

[b]A few weeks ago Gearbox Entertainment purchased the Risk of Rain IP from Hopoo Games[/b]

Gearbox have been the trusted publisher of Risk of Rain 2 for many years now, they have a love for Risk of Rain that matches our own and are the best fit for taking the franchise into the future.

[b]Hopoo Games will remain the developer of the Gearbox-published Risk of Rain Returns, and Gearbox will both develop and publish potential future titles in the series. [/b]

Looking back on the development of Survivors of the Void, we’re proud of what we accomplished. It was our goal to deliver all our remaining content ideas in a meaningful way. Building it for all of you has been a dream come true. But we didn’t do it alone. 

Our Risk of Rain 2 co-developer, Gearbox, created some of the most well-received content in the Survivors of the Void Expansion such as the stages like Aphelian Sanctuary and Siphoned Forest. They also made some of the coolest enemies in the game like Void Jailers.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/22894e5d74a8fa6f30a0d8a7c9e02def3601e54e.png[/img]

We are ready to move on to new challenges and welcome the exciting and fresh ideas Gearbox will bring to Risk of Rain. Completing the console versions of Survivors of the Void remains a top priority for Gearbox, and we can't wait to see what the future brings for Risk of Rain with them at the helm! We know the IP is in excellent hands. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

Thanks again for your support everyone! Make sure you’re following us on [url=https://twitter.com/hopoogames]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.twitch.tv/hopoo_games]Twitch[/url] for more info and tune in next time for even more info about [b]Risk of Rain Returns![/b]

Jonathan
Community Manager
Hopoo Games

notes.title: Risk of Rain 2 - Survivors of the Void - Patch 1.2.4
notes.content:
[h3]Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void PC Patch v1.2.4 (Build ID  #8796679)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a38b87cce68fc90f9e5946095455f3b24d44d0c5.png[/img]

Changes with the ‘🌧’ icon in front of them are changes or additions suggested by the community. As always, if you want to stay up to date on the game or give us feedback feel free to join the discord at https://discord.gg/riskofrain2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/8230a4fd45893eca28306973d7e0d68a41fba39b.png[/img]

The goal of this patch is to address lower-level bugs, while also taking a look at some content changes and more long-standing bugs that have existed in RoR2.  In addition to that, you can now sign up for our [b]mailing list[/b] in game to stay updated on our latest announcements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/909af96c81317f4db92b6050cfccf8e5a4b6ccd0.png[/img]
[i](Steam version only)[/i]

Read up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6322f6b264cab3c665e0d6eb2ac0a994ba830c3f.png[/img]

[b]• General[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Void Fields[/b]
[*] 🌧 Interactables now spawn in the stage
[i][*] Developer Notes:  With SotV, we wanted to make the Void Fields a more compelling choice by increasing the value of the reward and introducing a cost (time).  However, we felt that the risk outweighed the reward, so we’ve added interactables to the stage, much like the interactables in Simulacrum stages.[/i]

[*] [b]Artificer[/b]
[*]     🌧 Flame Bolt damage: 220% ⇒ 280%
[*]     Plasma Bolt damage: 220% ⇒ 280%
[i][*] Developer Notes:  As we iterated on the way that burns work during development of SotV, we unintentionally reduced the damage of Artificer’s Flame Bolt indirectly by reducing the burn damage.  To compensate, we’re buffing the initial damage of Flame Bolt so that the overall damage returns to pre-SotV levels.  Plasma Bolt is receiving the same buff to ensure it doesn’t fall behind.[/i]

[*] [b]Captain[/b]
[*]     🌧 Lysate Cell now increases the stocks of Captain’s first beacon
[*]     Captain is now limited to 2 deployed beacons at a time
[i][*] Developer Notes:  It was kind of lame that Lysate Cell did absolutely nothing for Captain, but it was hard to find a solution that wasn’t completely game-breaking.  Limiting the beacons to 2 at a time keeps the power of the item under control (as well as fixes some exploits in Simulacrum multiplayer).[/i]

[*] [b]Newly Hatched Zoea[/b]
[*]     🌧 Fresh new skins to help differentiate allies from enemies

[*] [b]Defense Nucleus[/b]
[*]     Alpha Construct Ally Damage Bonus: +0% ⇒+300%
[*]     Alpha Construct Ally Health Bonus: +0% ⇒ +300%
[i][*] Developer Notes: During development, we experimented with what conditions would trigger this item.  Initially, this item was exceptionally strong due to how frequently it triggered.  It proved to be too strong, so we changed the trigger, but we forgot to compensate by buffing the spawned Alpha Construct as we had intended.[/i]

[*] [b]Squid Polyp[/b]
[*]     Squid Turret Ally Base Damage: 20 ⇒ 4
[*]     Squid Turret Ally Primary Skill Damage Coefficient: 1 ⇒ 5
[*] Squid Turret Allies Primary Skill Proc Coefficient:  1 ⇒ 0.1
[*] Squid Turret Allies Primary Skill Knockback Force:  0 ⇒ 2000
[*]     Squid Turret Allies can now be stunned by “stunning” skills
[*]             Squid Turret Allies can now be frozen
[i][*] Developer Notes: An important part of the balance of the Void Cradles is the risk from the Void Infestors it spawns, so we wanted to lower the risk with Squid Polyp without completely removing it.  These changes to Squid Polyp are overall a slight buff in the hands of the player (the knockback especially defends the turrets against infestation), but they mainly reduce the damage from Collapse when Voidtouched.  And believe it or not, they’re actually pretty good at killing the Void Infestors.[/i]

[*][b] Blind Vermin[/b]
[*]         🌧 Director Credits for default variant:  20 ⇒ 14
[*] 🌧 Director Credits for snowy variant:  8 ⇒ 14
[i][*] Developer Notes: The difference in Director Credits between the variants of Blind Vermin was unintentional, so we just split the difference.[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/635162f6b67b38c1ad06037bf7644a731913edb6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 🌧 Swapping between skills on cooldown no longer resets the timer to max
[*] 🌧 Improved some exception handling for modders
[*] 🌧 Fixing a bug for modders where stages wouldn’t spawn monsters properly unless the deprecated DirectorCardCategorySelection field was assigned
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/b4482096b21eebc7ee418f8e6e50de7b9d1d7b67.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 🌧 Fixed nodes in Distant Roost, Titanic Plains, Wetland Aspect, and Simulacrum’s Rally Point Delta
[*] 🌧 [i]Finally[/i] fixed Volcanic Egg desynchronizing its position
[*] 🌧 Fixed Loader’s pylon traveling different distances depending on whether the player is a host or a client
[*] 🌧 Fixed various typos and logbook descriptions
[*] 🌧 Fixed various null reference exceptions
[*] 🌧 Fixed Ben’s Raincoat, Shuriken, Oddly-Shaped Opal, Red Whip, and Unstable Tesla Coil to properly clean up their buffs when the item is removed
[*] 🌧 Fixed Distant Roost and Wetland Aspect to properly spawn monsters and interactables from SotV
[*] 🌧 Fixed Little Disciple becoming disabled for the remainder of the stage after the character is rooted
[*] Updated Safer Spaces’ cooldown to no longer round up to the nearest second
[*] 🌧 [!!SPOILER!!] [spoiler]Fixed the music not progressing properly for clients during the new final boss fight[/spoiler]
[*] 🌧 Fixed Overheat (the debuff applied by Grandparents) to be properly marked as a debuff
[*] 🌧 Fixed bugs with Happiest Mask and Xi Construct
[*] 🌧 [!!SPOILER!!] [spoiler]Fixed a bug where the players could lose after teleporting off of the moon[/spoiler]
[*] 🌧 Fixed some collision on Commencement, Sundered Grove, and Sulfur Pools to prevent softlocks
[*] 🌧 Fixed bugs with Happiest Mask and Xi Construct
[*] 🌧 Updated Spare Drone Parts to be blacklisted for enemies
[*] 🌧 Improved the logic for where we spawn the item from Trophy Hunter’s Tricorn to reduce the odds that the item is inaccessible
[*] 🌧 Singularity Bands can no longer proc themselves
[*] 🌧 Fixed issues with players desynching with cross-play enabled
[*] 🌧 Fixed the logbook icon for Void Barnacle sometimes being pixelated
[*] 🌧 Fixed allies sometimes displaying healthbar indicators for items they didn’t have
[*] 🌧 Fixed Artifact of Sacrifice’s interactable credit reduction not working in Simulacrum
[*] 🌧 Fixed Void Fiend sometimes being partially invisible
[*] 🌧 Helfire Tincture’s self-inflicted burn will now remain non-lethal, even if upgraded by Ignition Tank
[*] 🌧 Helfire Tincture’s burn tick damage cap now considers shields, preventing issues with the burns becoming very long
[*] 🌧 Updated Bandit’s displays for 57 Leaf Clover, Benthic Bloom, Ocular Hud, and Focus Crystal
[*] 🌧 Updated Railgunner’s displays for Charged Perforator and Disposable Missile Launcher
[*] 🌧 Updated Equipment Drone’s display for Remote Caffeinator
[*] 🌧 Updated Void Reaver’s display for the Mending elite affix

We are also expecting to push another very small patch (1.2.4.2) within the next couple of weeks which will fix the following issues:[list]
[*] 🌧 Fixed prices in multiplayer sometimes being too cheap on the first stage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

As ever - [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who has given us feedback and reported bugs since the launch of the expansion, we appreciate each and every one of you! To keep up to date with any further updates please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RiskofRain]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/riskofrain2]Discord[/url]. Also don't forget the new [b]Mailing List[/b] you can sign up for from the in-game menu, and for those of you not able to access that we're going to have a web-based sign-up soon!
