notes.title: Dev Thoughts #27 - Developer Q&A + more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/26d098ef4940d4e4a16f2e75ae2b21bf311be473.png[/img]

Hello again everyone! It’s been a while since our pre-release Dev Thoughts and we’ve got a few new thoughts to share with you!

I strongly recommend watching the video version of the Dev Thoughts this month as it includes all the below content as well as a lengthy [b]Community Q&A Interview [/b]with the co-founders of Hopoo Games - Duncan and Paul. 
[list]
[*] Where did the name “Hopoo” come from?

[*] Who is to blame for Captain’s abilities not being available in hidden realms?

[*] DEADBOLT 2 WHEN? 
[/list]
Find out the answers to these questions and many more by watching the below video!

[previewyoutube=r3nI1HqkL9A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Expansion Reception[/h3]

First off let’s start off with the reception of Survivors of the Void. [b]We have been absolutely blown away with the positive reaction to the expansion![/b] We are thrilled that you’re loving the DLC, and despite some early balance/bug issues that we have adjusted as quickly as possible, you stuck with us and are playing Risk of Rain 2 in record numbers!

So once again, from the bottom of our hearts, a huge [b]thank you[/b] from everyone here at Hopoo Games for being part of this - [i]we couldn’t do it without you![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Console Release[/h3]

Since the PC release of Survivors of the Void we have been busy ironing out all the bugs and balance changes needed to get the expansion - and Risk of Rain 2 as a whole - up to the best standard. In order to release the console versions simultaneously to this same standard, including all the improvements we’ve already made to the PC version, we have made the decision to move the Console release of Survivors of the Void to later this year in early Q4.

This was not an easy choice to make however we want to ensure your experience playing Risk of Rain 2 is the same regardless of the platform you chose, moving the date will allow us to deliver the game on all Console platforms in the state you deserve. We know this will be disappointing news for some of you however we know that in the long run this is the best move to make for the future of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Merch Update[/h3]

Just a quick update here - you may have seen on Twitter or Discord a couple of months ago that I asked what you’d like to see as far as Hopoo Games merchandise is concerned and I’ve taken that feedback and [b]we are well on our way to opening a merch store for you![/b]

We have secured a partner to bring this merch to you and we are finalising designs right now - but don’t worry we will absolutely let you know when we’re ready to open!

As you can tell from this secret snippet of an email - [b]we have something special in store for you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/fef2ea42be20aab3f8288bb532631ae066cc966a.png[/img]
[i]oooh[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Survivors of the Void Patch 1.2.4[/h3]

We have already updated Survivors of the Void twice since release and we are planning on at least one more bug fix patch before we consider Survivors of the Void completed on PC. This patch mainly focuses on bugs so there will not be much in the way of balance or content changes this time - however one change we’ve made is to recolor any ally Void creatures on your team to make them easier to identify in the chaos of combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/484f29dc06356b44a83f0742d7eb1acc90829140.png[/img]
[i]Your special blue crabbos.[/i]

Another big [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who has taken the time to report any gameplay or bug issues to us over the last couple of months - this is incredibly valuable information for us to improve the game and we really appreciate it! There is still time to report any bugs you may have experienced since the 1.2.3 Patch - let us know by joining our Discord and reporting them in the #bug-reports-pc channel

[url=https://discord.gg/riskofrain2]https://discord.gg/riskofrain2[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

Thanks again to everyone for making the Survivors of the Void launch an amazing experience - don't forget to check out the video dev thoughts above for the Q&A with Duncan and Paul - and I'll see you next time, we can’t wait to show you what we’ve been [b]cooking[/b] up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/7b57b6c0bd1357222a4c1b2b8a03001c3cc6e35e.gif[/img]

Jonathan
Community Manager
Hopoo Games

notes.title: Risk of Rain 2 - Survivors of the Void - Patch 1.2.3
notes.content:
[h3]Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void PC Patch v1.2.3 (Build ID  #8537997)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3e591755c10f0caf10c7ee02d5e1bdf3bfe99326.png[/img]

Changes with the ‘🌧’ icon in front of them are changes or additions suggested by the community. As always, if you want to stay up to date on the game or give us feedback feel free to join the discord at https://discord.gg/riskofrain2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/8230a4fd45893eca28306973d7e0d68a41fba39b.png[/img]

The goal of this patch is to address lower-level bugs, while also taking a look at some content changes and more long-standing bugs that have existed in RoR2.

Read up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6322f6b264cab3c665e0d6eb2ac0a994ba830c3f.png[/img]

[b][*] Simulacrum[/b][list]
[*] Slightly updated visuals of Void Focus
[*] Now has an indicator for the Void Focus’ position
[/list]
[b][*] Void Seeds[/b][list]
[*] 🌧 Now cap at a maximum of 3 per map
[*] 🌧 Spawn less frequently with Artifact of Sacrifice enabled
[*] 🌧 Spawn less frequently on top of you when starting a new stage
[/list]
[b][*] Void Fiend[/b][list]
[*]     🌧 Corrupted skills are now lower priority than Heresy items, allowing Heresy items to override both versions of skills
[/list]
[b][*] Goobo Jr.[/b][list]
[*]     🌧 Damage Bonus: +70% ⇒+200%
[*]     🌧 Health Bonus: +70% ⇒ +200%
[*] 🌧 Fix description in logbook being wrong
[*] [i]Developer Notes: Goobo was designed to be +600%. It was +70%. +600% was actually waaay too strong when we fixed it, so we set it to a more reasonable value.[/i][/list]
[b][*] Brittle Crown[/b][list]
[*]     🌧 No longer grants gold to the enemy who hits you while wearing the item (but still shows the visuals)
[*] [i]Developer Notes: We thought it would be a cute behavior if when losing money from Brittle Crown, it granted that money to the attacker - for use in stuff like a Scavenger’s Crowd Funder. However, this resulted in you gaining all the money back when you killed the enemy, making Brittle Crown have (essentially) no downside.[/i][/list]
[b][*] Ben’s Raincoat[/b][list]
[*] Rework behavior - Now has an internal cooldown of 5 seconds
[*] Now blocks 1 (+1 per stack) debuffs before going on cooldown
[*] Now grants 10% of your health as barrier when blocking a debuff
[*] Now has the ‘Healing’ tag
[*] No longer grants maximum health
[*] 🌧 No longer blocks non-timed debuffs, like Eclipse 8 and skills like Power Mode
[*] [i]Developer Notes: Ben’s Raincoat was a very binary item, resulting in unsatisfying stacking behavior and frustrations when given to monsters (like in Simulacrum). The item also trivialized Eclipse 8. Now, it has a bit of downtime for when it can block debuffs - and since we didn’t want this to be just a net nerf, we also added a large barrier when blocking a debuff with the coat.[/i][/list] 
[b][*] Void Devastator[/b][list] 
[*] Max Health: 2100 (+630 per level) ⇒ 2800 (+840 per level)
[*] Armor: 10 ⇒ 20
[*] [i]Developer Notes: Despite being a boss monster, the Void Devastator had strangely low stats for its cost, especially when compared to same-cost monsters like the Imp Overlord[/i][/list]
[b][*] Gup[/b][list]
[*] 🌧 No longer splits if killed from a ‘Void Death’, like from Lost Seer’s Lenses
[*] Voidtouched Gups and Geeps will now split into Voidtouched Geeps and Gips (respectively)[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/635162f6b67b38c1ad06037bf7644a731913edb6.png[/img]

[list][*] Altered some planets in the Planetarium
[*] Updated Captain’s Defense Matrix log to be granted by playing Captain
[*] 🌧 Updated Shipping Request Form to be blacklisted for enemies
[*] 🌧 Updated inventories to work with more than 255 items for mods with many items
[*] 🌧 Made it easier for mods to register custom achievements
[*] 🌧 Updated localization to allow mods to properly utilize the system
[*] 🌧 Extended systems to support mods adding custom item tiers
[*] 🌧 Pluripotent Larva will no longer convert into items that are not available in the current run
[*] 🌧 Updated a deep pool in the Planetarium causing you to get stuck inside if you had no jump boosts
[*] 🌧 Updated Heretic to receive Heresy items, even if spawned from Goobo Jr, so it can use abilities
[*] 🌧 Fixed Korean language files having a malformed format, resulting in errors[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/b4482096b21eebc7ee418f8e6e50de7b9d1d7b67.png[/img]

[list][*] 🌧 Fixed Category Chests dropping a much smaller subset of items
[*] 🌧 Fixed Beetle Guard summoned from Queen’s Gland no longer being a fresh green color
[*] 🌧 Fixed a variety of issues relating to Heresy items losing or gaining stocks when swapping skills with other skills
[*] 🌧 Fixed Simulacrum referring to Rainstorm as Normal
[*] 🌧 Removed nodes in Simulacrum’s Titanic Plains, Sulfur Pools, and Rallypoint Delta that were inside walls
[*] 🌧 Removed nodes in Aphelian Sanctuary and Sulfur Pools that were inside walls
[*]  Fixed tag requirements of Vengeance and Void Fields
[*] Fixed a bunch of NRE’s, causing a potential variety of issues
[*] 🌧 Fixed profiles not being able to be deleted in the main menu
[*] 🌧 Fixed out-of-bound zones for Aphelian Sanctuary, Void Fields, Distant Roost, Titanic Plains, and Sky Meadows not properly culling monsters
[*] 🌧 Fixed Siphoned Forest being called Snowy Forest in the logbook
[*] 🌧 [!!SPOILER!!][spoiler]Fixed the frog not spawning a deep void portal[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed text for Blast Shower not clarifying that it also removes freezes and stuns
[*] 🌧 Fixed visible back faces in Siphoned Forest
[*] 🌧 Fixed Void Fiend’s Trespass continually playing the sound if you quit in the middle of the skill
[*] 🌧 Fixed Disposable Missile Launcher and Fireworks not triggering other missile effects, like AtG Missile and Plasma Shrimp
[*] 🌧 Fixed a few bugs with state-controlled debuffs (like Void Fiend’s Corrupted Flood) and Ben’s Raincoat causing those debuffs to be permanent
[*] 🌧 Fixed REX’s core position being lowered while sprinting, causing AI issues and some projectiles appearing in the floor while sprinting
[*] 🌧 Fixed Bulwark’s Ambry entry missing in logbook
[*] Fixed Heretic’s head hurtbox causing issues when hit
[*] Fixed Xi Construct and Void Jailer appearing with Artifact of Dissonance enabled, even with the DLC disabled
[*] 🌧 Fixed Simulacrum button being there even if the DLC is disabled
[*] 🌧 Fixed Pluripotent Larva not corrupting all items that map many-to-one (i.e., Runald’s Band + yellow items)
[*] 🌧 Fixed Railgunner seeing her own Weak Points while Chaos is enabled
[*] 🌧 Fixed camera issues with Frost Relic while using Railgunner’s scopes or Mul-T’s Power Mode
[*] 🌧 Fixed issues with Gup / Geep / Gip and Dio’s Best Friend
[*] 🌧 Fixed Collapse counting as two separate debuffs
[*] Fixed Geep and Gip receiving items from Evolution and Simulacrum multiple times
[*] Potentially fixing more cases where Simulacrum would fail to spawn enemies
[*] Fixed various typos[/list]

Once again thanks very much for everyone who has jumped in and played Survivors of the Void and [i]especially[/i] everyone that has reported these bugs! We're planning on at least one more bugfix/balance patch for the expansion so If you have any further issues with any of the above, or find any new bugs ([b]impossible[/b]) please keep letting us know!

-Hopoo Games

notes.title: Risk of Rain 2 - Survivors of the Void - Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
[h3]Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void PC Patch v1.2.2.0 (Build ID #8331485)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/5b3dd3fc5a49649fe8ec5b3b7c401f27c6a80809.png[/img]

Changes with the ‘🌧’ icon in front of them are changes or additions suggested by the community. As always, if you want to stay up to date on the game or give us feedback feel free to join the discord at https://discord.gg/riskofrain2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/8230a4fd45893eca28306973d7e0d68a41fba39b.png[/img]

The goal of this patch is to address bugs from the release of Survivors of the Void, alongside community-driven balance and design changes. Read up! For some context, check out our previous Dev Thoughts:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/632360/view/3114807061130869250

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6322f6b264cab3c665e0d6eb2ac0a994ba830c3f.png[/img]

[b][*] General[/b][list]
[*] Added Steam achievements for the DLC!
[/list]
[b][*] Simulacrum[/b][list]
[*] Waves now skip if nothing has spawned for 60 seconds
[*] Waves now have a limit of how many credits can be given out at once
[*] Waves will now spawn slightly more elites, and slightly less normal monsters
[*] Artifact of Kin will always spawn monsters, even if they are considered ‘cheap’
[*] Developer Notes: Simulacrum has a few edge cases where the director fails to spawn monsters - and as a result, the gamemode no longer advances. We added a few different checks to address situations where the game gets stuck. Not only that, but simulacrum tended to spam a lot more normal monsters instead of elites - so now, it’ll spawn a little bit more elite-y.
[/list]
[b][*] Void Seeds[/b][list]
[*] Void Seeds no longer spawn monsters over time, or when the Teleporter starts
[*] Void Seeds no longer occasionally spawns normal, non-Voidtouched monsters
[*] Void Seeds now have a more clear area indicator
[*] Void Seeds no longer spawn ‘naked’ Void Infestors
[*] Void Seeds now scale a lot slower over the duration of the run
[*] Void Seeds now spawn elite affixes (like Overloading and Mending) less frequently for its Void 
monsters
[*] 🌧 Void Seeds now spawn Void Caches with Sacrifice enabled
[*] 🌧 Void Seeds now mark remaining enemies on the map if there are 3 or less
[*] Developer Notes: Void Seeds are chaotic and strange by design - but that same chaos and strangeness can lead to a bit of frustration in what the heck is going on. We’ve clarified behavior, and fixed some weird edge-case scenarios that led to it being more confusing. We’re still taking a look at trying to reduce the frequency of it spawning right on top of you at stage start.
[/list]
[b][*] Void Portal[/b][list]
[*] Minimum Stage Count: 3 ⇒ 6
[*] Developer Notes: It’s pretty much impossible to beat The Planetarium at stage 3, so it was just bait. Now it only spawns when a player could reasonably beat the objectives.
[/list]
[b][*] Prismatic Trials (Live with SotV release)[/b][list]
[*] Prismatic Trials now has Survivors of the Void permanently enabled, even for non-DLC owners
[/list]
[b][*] Eclipse (Live with SotV release)[/b][list]
[*] Eclipse is now available in multiplayer
[/list]
[b][*] Ignite (Live with SotV release)[/b][list]
[*] Ignite effects, like Blazing elites and Artificer’s Flame Bolt, now deal 50% of its damage over time as ignite
[*] Developer Notes: Previously, ignite damage was calculated off of a weird version of base damage, which was inconsistent across enemies. Not only that, but Artificer’s ignite was handled quite differently than the Blazing elites. Now, ignite effects always deal half the damage of the impact - which makes it match Overloading elite damage as well.
[/list]
[b][*] Void Fog (Live with SotV release)[/b][list]
[*] Void fog damage now ignores armor, Tougher Times, Armor Plating, and Planula
[*] Void fog damage now slowly ramps up over time as long as you remain in the fog
[*] Developer Notes: The Void Fog is important for a lot of content, especially in SotV - and has to remain threatening for the events to work. We found that Tougher Times, Armor Plating, and Planula made some of this content arbitrarily too easy. We also wanted to avoid being able to go ‘infinite’ in the fog with a lot of healing-over-time, so now it ramps up slowly.
[/list]
[b][*] Artificer[/b][list]
[*] 🌧 ‘Flamethrower’ now scales the number of damage ticks with attack speed
[/list]
[b][*] Void Fiend[/b][list]
[*] 🌧 ‘Drown (Corrupted)’ now scales the number of damage ticks with attack speed
[*] 🌧 ‘Suppress (Corrupted)’ no longer marks you as the attacker for its self-damage - meaning it won’t proc items on yourself like Crowbar, etc.
[*] 🌧 Transitioning into Corrupted mode now grants 0.5 seconds of invincibility
[/list]
[b][*] Void Fields[/b][list]
[*] 🌧 Percent Health Damage: 5% per second ⇒ 2.5% per second
[*] Developer Notes: We wanted to make Void Fields more oppressive in SotV, as a mobility/heal check before you can access the guaranteed portal into the Planetarium. It was too much, so we are reducing it.
[/list]
[b][*] Stages[/b][list]
[*] Planetarium music now advances every phase
[/list]
[b][*] Void Infestors[/b][list]
[*] 🌧 Void Infestors now slowly decay health over 30 seconds
[*] 🌧 Void Infestors no longer can convert ‘mechanical’ targets, like Drones or Engineer Turrets 
[*] Developer Notes: While it was cool the first time, having Void Infestors instantly kill your hard-earned drones made drones even worse. Now, they’re a decent ally to help pick off those bugs. Not only that, but an infestor that’s stuck running around the edge of a map would prevent you from finishing the Void Seed, which was annoying - now they slowly lose health over time.
[/list]
[b][*] Items[/b][list]
[*] Spare Drone Parts no longer grants Col. Droneman to Engineer Turrets
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/b4482096b21eebc7ee418f8e6e50de7b9d1d7b67.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 🌧 Fixed ‘Remote Caffeinator’ DLC equipment being locked permanently
[*] 🌧 Fixed weird momentum/velocity behavior after falling out-of-bounds and teleporting back
[*] 🌧 Fixed ignite effects from Fire affixes and the ‘ignite’ damage type dealing 2x the damage over 4x the duration
[*] 🌧 Fixed Volcanic Egg disjointing its position over time
[*] Fixed clients who disconnect and then reconnect being stuck spectating
[*] 🌧 Fixed Railgunner’s Goobo Jr. AI using only its Primary ability
[*] 🌧 Fixed Ignition Tank’s descriptions being inaccurate to its behavior
[*] Fixed hosts not being able to create new multiplayer games if they disconnect and reconnect their internet
[*] 🌧 Fixed Merc’s expose being consumed by non-Mercs
[*] 🌧 Fixed Simulacrum’s Enigma wave having the wrong strings
[*] 🌧 Fixed Void Devastator not having its boss item assigned, causing it to not drop or be targetable by Trophy Hunter’s Tricorn
[*] 🌧 Fixed Newly Hatched Zoea not consuming Defense Nucleus
[*] 🌧 Fixed a stray jump pad in Sulfur Pools that leads nowhere
[*] 🌧 Fixed ‘crusty’ pixels around buff icons
[*] 🌧 Fixed Distant Roost having less interactable credits than Titanic Plains, causing it to spawn less interactables
[*] 🌧 Fixed Rusted Key always granting a red item
[*] Fixed consecutive weak point tracking resetting whenever ANY player missed, not just the player trying to earn the achievement
[*] Fixed Will-o-the-wisp/Voidsent Flame having reversed damage coefficients
[*] Fixed Prismatic Trials being playable in multiplayer by starting a singleplayer prismatic trial, backing out, and then hosting a multiplayer game
[*] Fixed cans not animating properly with Remote Caffeinator
[*] Fixed Snowy, Natural, and Sandy Golem skins not being fully implemented
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/37164a23a4cfa4e1619a59e5ee8b6b59a5450b09.png[/img]
[i]Ice to see you :¬)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/1804999bb34be826c54f3807810d9563ffee1be1.png[/img]

We’re keeping an eye on:
[list]
[*] Reports of new crashes as of SotV release
[*] Category Chests dropping limited items
[*] Other potential softlocks in Simulacrum
[/list]


As you can see we have made quite a few fixes and changes directly based on your feedback, so a big thank you to everyone who has been in touch to report any issues! Keep this feedback coming -[b] it really helps![/b]

-Hopoo Games

notes.title: Dev Thoughts 26.5 - What a Launch! Patch incoming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3567796e9b23e5b9c293b5f6249f5d0471636293.png[/img]

[b]
Hello everyone!
[/b]

Before we get started today a [b]HUGE[/b] thank you from everyone here at Hopoo Games for jumping in and trying Survivors of the Void - we have had an absolute blast watching your streams and tweets and Discord posts about your brand new Risk of Rain 2 experiences! For us as a team, SotV was definitely the most ambitious thing we’ve done to date and we’re thrilled with the reception!

[b]We’re currently working on a patch [/b]that should fix most of the issues you have reported to us, along with some balance/gameplay changes. Please note that these are [b]only some[/b] of the changes we’re working on, and we will provide [b]full patch notes[/b] for these changes on release!

Oh yea… [i]patch notes[/i]. We’ve learned from our mistake on not releasing patch notes for the expansion’s release - we recognize that many of you were used to how the game played prior to Survivors of the Void, and not informing you of the changes was something we have learned from - [b]we will ensure future updates are well documented!
[/b]
On that subject… [b]Some of the things we’re working on are:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixing velocity/momentum changes after teleporting back into the map, causing you to be flung around
[*] Fixing one of the DLC Equipment being permanently locked
[*] Fixing a few issues with the boss item from the Void Devastator
[*] Fixing profiles not being deleted through the main menu
[*] Fixing Volcanic Egg disjointing over time
[*] Improving clarity, balance, and behaviour on Void Seeds. It’s fairly confusing, and spawning inside of it, being unable to find the enemies, or randomly dying to it isn’t a fun experience.
[*] Improving Goobo Railgunner AI
[*] Reducing damage of updated Void Fields’ fog
[*] Captain occasionally spawns in with no stocks of his Special
[*] Simulacrum soft-locks
[*] Fixing Rusty Lockbox from always dropping a red item
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e66de4ff6f5312faab3184d6d5db6b3e11bdc81a.png[/img]
[i]Forever in our hearts[/i]

[b]Some things we’re keeping an eye on:[/b]

[list]
[*] Difficulty and overall balance of new content
[*] Duration of some ignite effects
[*] Improving functionality internally for modders
[*] Frustrations with Void Infestors, specifically with drones and turrets
[/list]

Again, I wanted to say thank you to each and every one of you - it's been an amazing experience launching Survivors of the Void and we're truly grateful to have such a passionate fanbase! Please keep the feedback and bug reports coming - we’re watching and listening! 

-Hopoo Games

P.S.

Risk of Rain 2 Trading cards are now live on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a03bb6fca47d53ac1580ec746ab87e198be24fee.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #26 - Survivor #2 Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/88cc7966f524be86b627650d83e65e546bc2d42e.png[/img]

[h1]Dev Thoughts #26 - The Void Invades[/h1]

[previewyoutube=TM-XQOYzxy8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone! 

This will be the last Dev Thoughts before the release of Survivors of the Void on PC on the 1st March! I can’t explain how excited we all are at Hopoo Games for you all to get your hands on the expansion - [b]We’re very proud of the final product and we hope you all enjoy it[/b] - be sure to let us know what you think!

Thank you to [b]everyone[/b] who has followed along with each of the Dev Thoughts over the last 5 months, it’s been a wild ride and it's been great talking with you all - [b]this won't be the last time you hear from me as we do have some more surprises for you in the not-too-distant future![/b]

Following last month’s reveal of the [b]Railgunner[/b] the anticipation for release of [b]Survivors of the Void[/b] has skyrocketed and I have a couple of release updates for you all before we get into the main subject of this month’s Dev Thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Release Updates[/h3]

Firstly I'm happy to announce that for the first time we’re releasing Risk of Rain 2 and Survivors of the Void on the [b]Epic Game Store[/b]. It will launch at the same time as the Steam version on March 1st and the Expansion will have the same limited special offer price on launch we announced last month for Steam - [b]a 35% discount down to $9.75[/b]

The Epic Store version will be multiplayer compatible with the Steam version so[b] you’ll be able to play together with your friends no matter which PC version you own.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/018c5c1433d109aa31121afc4d0aad32f98771fd.png[/img]
[i]Explore stinky new worlds with your pals[/i]

Secondly i’d like to give an update to our console fans as many of you have been back in contact with me since last month excited to give the Railgunner a try - While I dont have a precise date for you just yet I can confirm that as mentioned in Dev Thoughts 23 [b]we are still on schedule for a Q2 (April-June) release for the console versions[/b] and I will let you know as soon as possible when the exact release date will be. 

And finally I know many of you - like myself - are huge fans of the RoR2 soundtrack and want to get your hands on the new music we previewed last month - [b]You can now pre-order the Survivors of the Void OST on Chris’s Bandcamp on the following link:[/b]

[url=https://chrischristodoulou.bandcamp.com/album/risk-of-rain-2-survivors-of-the-void]https://chrischristodoulou.bandcamp.com/album/risk-of-rain-2-survivors-of-the-void[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Survivor #2[/h3]

Introducing the second of two Survivors arriving with the Expansion

[b]The Void Fiend.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/98823a600f36f05bea95e07b3f8a593198acf24c.png[/img]

The Void Fiend is Risk of Rain 2’s very own Jekyll and Hyde - [b]a Void corrupted survivor that fluctuates between a controlled form and corrupted form, each with different strengths and weaknesses. [/b]

Key to mastering the two sides of the Void Fiend is [b]Corruption[/b] - which is increased by taking damage, reduced by healing but always slowly creeping higher and higher.

The Void Fiend doesn’t have a set of alternate abilities to choose from  - once your Corruption reaches 100% you burst into a more aggressive form with [b]4 new abilities to master.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/13054b92bf8913d7205902006df05251defbb277.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

While in this form your [b]Corruption[/b] slowly decreases - giving you a short window to use these more powerful abilities before transforming back into your controlled form and reliving this curse over and over. 

[h3]Drown[/h3]

In your controlled form[b] Drown[/b] fires a slowing long-range beam for 300% damage - a great all-round weapon that does high damage and has built in crowd control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/953aa72a9049942d258b5d382fd8105fbe552153.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

In your corrupted form Drown transforms into a short-range rapid-fire beam that[b] rips and tears[/b] through your enemies foolish enough to attack you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3210c2275cfebb5653a5a598426f6905c22fdd75.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[h3]Flood[/h3]

Using your huge mutated crustacean arm-cannon fire a plasma missile for 600% damage - you can also charge this attack building to an explosive plasma ball instead, dealing 1100% damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/dec52456d7f54eb1889f296b203aad2f54132e48.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

In your corrupted form not only does this attack instantly fire a 1100% damage arcing bomb it also has [i]twice[/i] the explosive radius.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/459bb47fee27a2e1e3b1944916f41d7b313f2986.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[h3]Trespass[/h3]

The Void Fiend can vanish into the void for a short time which [b]cleanses all debuffs[/b] while you move in an upward arc - great for escaping tough situations or for navigating to higher ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/52f4ff11d470cc537d1d5962a118c69eb3c36e04.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

In your corrupted form this turns into an [b]aggressive leap[/b] forward through the void allowing you to quickly close the distance to decimate your enemies up close and personal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/7fa141ccc8107086359151d052a2f98f3c294b11.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[h3]Suppress [/h3]

[b]Suppress[/b] is Void Fiend’s way of maintaining whichever form you wish to stay in a little bit longer. In your controlled form you consume 25% corruption and convert it into instant 25% healing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/bdf033afa8c05de462305c855fff2effc94bf558.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

In your corrupted form you crush 25% of your health to instead increase your corruption by 25% allowing you to stay in this powerful form a few seconds longer to unleash the power of the void - [b]if you can afford the price.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a05b0caf79b2b38a63677bbd7b628ebd839291f1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

You can also watch some exclusive Void Fiend gameplay footage over on the IGN website:

https://www.ign.com/videos/2022/02/15/risk-of-rain-2-13-minutes-of-void-fiend-gameplay

That concludes our..

「?TR?ESPASS】

.... What was that?

Oh God they’re getting clo… 

『FLOO?D】

…the crabs… ..they’ve found me….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/c1f014e4f476904beaedc3f89c740911471c5b47.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #25 - Survivor and Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e4212b70c271796a38595efacf8e4c9267b84a4d.png[/img]

[h1]Dev Thoughts #25 - Don’t Say The “S” Word[/h1]

Welcome back and Happy New Year!

This is going to be a [b]BIG[/b] year for Hopoo Games and I cannot wait to tell you more about what we have in store for you in the future - for today we’ll start with meeting a new friend!

[b]Don’t forget the Dev Thoughts also comes in a super-sweet video format![/b] I’ve done something slightly different this month - let me know what you think in the comments!

[previewyoutube=RQaRgzbt-PY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Before we meet our new friend[/b]… Some big announcements are in order!

[b]The Risk of Rain 2 Expansion - Survivors of the Void - will launch on Steam on March 1st 2022[/b]

[b]The SRP of the Expansion will be $15 - but for a short period at launch this will be discounted down to just $9.75!![/b]

Aaaaaand finally before we get into the rest of the Dev Thoughts  - check out the Steam Page which has been freshly updated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607890/Survivors_of_the_Void

Now its time to meet the first of two new playable characters in [b]Survivors of the Void.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Railgunner[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/5ae2315a605df1525b769b0aa0fe71b30765a89a.png[/img]

Railgunner is a specialist at long range single-target massive damage. She has a number of [b]unique tools and mechanics[/b] that make her the queen of making anything in her sights turn into a red mist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e4ee72251b1fa6d45a2719b2407d0916271d1328.png[/img]
[i]Or into pink blobs of beetle brains[/i]

This month’s Dev Thoughts is devoted to showcasing the Railgunner’s abilities - first up is her iconic [b]M99 Sniper mode[/b] (Oops.. I said the S word already.)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]M99 Sniper[/h3]

Activate your long-range scope, highlighting [b]Weak Points[/b] and transforming your weapon into a [b]piercing 1000% damage railgun.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/b9a13d06b09944476dff3636b882c12e906ddadb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]    

Unlike other survivors, [b]the Railgunner’s attacks cannot randomly crit[/b] - when you hit one of the highlighted [b]Weak Points[/b] through her scope you are[i] guaranteed[/i] a [b]Critical Strike[/b] - All Critical Strike Chance gained through items and equipment is converted into Critical Strike Damage.

After firing a shot the Railgunner’s [b]M99 Sniper[/b] mode starts an [b]Active Reload[/b] bar - a perfect reload lets you fire your next shot sooner and also makes that shot deal an additional [b]+500%[/b] base damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/821740cd03a10a2c53a4adcefa07186dcc339dd5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

Next up is Railgunner’s non-scoped attack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]XQR Smart Round System[/h3]

In a perfect world the Railgunner wouldn’t have to use the XQR Smart Round System - but as we’re all painfully aware[b] Petrichor V is not a perfect world…[/b]

When you’re not using the scope the railgun fires [b]rapid fire smart rounds[/b] that home in on enemies for 100% damage.

While it doesn't have the stopping power of the M99 Sniper - it certainly has its uses. It can help attack close range enemies that are swarming you

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/d56602a8b7f0238706925f7eafb8aca99ef2746a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

it can also quickly finish off those enemies that, [i]selfishly[/i], haven't quite died to a single railgun shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/9395a7353193b870d2d8a8a7b9438a3287f9c0d7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

Next up we have an ability that actually makes the Railgunner rival [i]Loader[/i] in maneuverability…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Concussion Device[/h3]

Railgunner utilises very versatile [b]Concussion Devices[/b] that have two primary uses.

Firstly with a well timed jump it can be used to propel yourself to high or distant places to escape danger or get a better vantage point

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/8680cb17d8d88525aa87196b40fa4e8bf7a2d6ae.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

(or both)

And it can also be used to knock back smaller enemies, breaking up dangerous packs making them easier to pick off one by one.

Its third secret use is that it makes damn cool trickshot-gifs for development blogs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/9e63d5b6ee9ecdf831c5ead1eb28d2d7786a7a08.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

And finally the pièce de résistance in Railgunner’s arsenal..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Supercharge[/h3]

Railgunner’s special ability is the [b]Supercharge[/b]. Briefly overloading her railgun turns it into a boss one-shotting beast - firing a huge piercing round for [b]4000% damage[/b] and [b]150% Weak Point damage.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/15e286ef3c2888d77866a8330459a42bb53d391c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[b]With this great power comes a big drawback[/b], once used ALL your railgun weapons are disabled for 5 seconds leaving you with just your [b]Concussion Device[/b] for defence - [i]you had better make that shot count![/i]

The Overcharge is also much wider than a usual shot - making it very useful for taking out large conga-lines of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e0ebde1404ad8d22d8b016eae196005c75a18976.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

It’s also very useful for killing that Solus Control Unit that always seems to spawn at the start of Sky Meadows from across the stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/968d19fd372ccc795a4675540dcc860db42e35d6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

And that concludes our deeper dive into Railgunner’s abilities! She does of course have[b] alternate abilities[/b] to unlock and an [b]alternate skin[/b] for beating the game on monsoon much like the other survivors - but i’ll leave those up to you to discover for yourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/63dc2bf82e656997b83ed672d9b07b95763f824f.png[/img]
[i]Let the speculation commence![/i]

Don’t forget to check out the [url=https://youtu.be/RQaRgzbt-PY]video Dev Thoughts[/url] above for some extended play footage of Railgunner & See you again soon when we will be very close to the release of [b]Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/046f8e4e7c091dc7b974405847754259a52e4728.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]    


Adios! 

Jonathan @ Hopoo Games

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/ac789f5acdeee10cec8326d64caf5715129cce14.png[/img]

[h1]Dev Thoughts #24 - Petrichor V Safari[/h1]

Greetings Goobo Jr Fan Club!

[h3]Dev Thoughts Video[/h3]

You know the drill by now - [b]Dev Thoughts also comes as a video![/b]

[previewyoutube=5sppVXVHuKE;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]You did smash it didn't you?[/i]

And before we crack on, don't forget to visit the [b]Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void[/b] Steam Page as it might have changed since your last visit…

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607890/Survivors_of_the_Void]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607890/Survivors_of_the_Void[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Console Update[/h3]

Since starting as Community Manager many of you within our console playing fanbase have asked me about the status of any updates in the future for Risk of Rain 2 - today I’m going to give you some fresh info.

Firstly, I’m happy to announce that it is our goal to release the upcoming RoR2 expansion [b]Survivors of the Void[/b] on console in Q2 of 2022, quite soon after the release of the Steam version in Q1 (both dates subject to change, but currently both still on schedule!)

[b]With the release of the expansion will also come an update where we have completely rebuilt the console version from the ground-up.[/b] The goal of this rebuild is to have much closer parity between the console and Steam versions of the game. 

This update should resolve most existing console-only bugs and -[i] In theory [/i]- any new bugs should no longer be platform specific which will make them easier to identify and fix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/10599b2575500436ec5dc0e67084f016370c3cd9.png[/img]
[i]In practice, there will definitely be new bugs.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Survivors Corner[/h3]

Last month I asked you to come up with some renditions of one of the new Void monsters arriving in Survivors of the Void and the response was much bigger than I expected, and in some cases much weirder than I expected.

These ranged from the [b]creative[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/ef1a9813a05669d9792d98f6097472cf7177bdf9.png[/img]

To the [b]funny[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/01ced224d6a9542a2578e8b4a6cbe6a3c2759f47.png[/img]

To the [b]strangely accurate[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/03ec18bcc76b9092c47ef6cb2b6f9cb984afa21e.png[/img]

Thank you to[b] everyone [/b]who sent me your versions of this mystery Void Monster, let’s take a visit to Petrichor V to see just how close you were...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h3]Petrichor Safari[/h3]

It’s time to go on a sightseeing tour of [b]Survivors of the Void[/b] to discover the environments and monsters that await you in the expansion.

Let’s begin by visiting the [b]Snowy Forest[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/d703887eaf08af8e1bdbf8f355648429d2fd26fc.png[/img]

The first monster we’ll find here today is not [i]from[/i] these once-peaceful lands - but instead invading from the Void. The [b]Void Jailer.[/b]

The Void Jailer is the master of putting you in your [i]place[/i]. It’s main attack is a powerful void-blast that slows your speed and its secondary attack is a entangling snare that locks you in place, leaving you at the mercy of this abomination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/5c945d1bfe59366839aee5ed386ba8d49ff8311b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

And if you manage to overcome this beast you had better get outta dodge REAL quick - those of you familiar with the Reavers know what happens when you manage to finally topple a Void enemy….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/fe04af6ca77cde82bebd5ada8d12c84abac8989f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[i]This was going to be a gif of the Void Jailer dying and doing that cool void-explosion but it kept killing me first so this is what you're getting instead.[/i]

Next up, one of the many enemies found high up in the [b]Aphelian Sanctuary...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3e2874c702ed434252d329c3a06d7d5d55024a8b.png[/img]

…is your new worst nightmare. [b]The Blind Pest.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e18ed75ca8a2f30df9b17573df9a4a09c3ab32b1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

Who... this guy? [i]Your worst nightmare?[/i] [b]Surely not?[/b]

Aww look at his cute fuzzy face, flapping ear-wings and swinging tongue. [b]What a cutie! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/61c78df305feacc19b72ca71a9b36b8e173ec636.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

Don’t let it's looks fool you, [i]I hate these things[/i], and you will too. If Lesser Wisps are the flying shotguns of RoR2, these [i]douchebags[/i] are the flying rifles. Dangerous in packs and deadly if ignored, get used to seeing this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/7b78113393e71a26ae4b58167fee9cdab2dfa091.png[/img]

Not every new monster in [b]Survivors of the Void[/b] will be completely unfamiliar. Our next monster is a returning enemy from a previous ill-fated visit to Petrichor V.

It’s big, it’s orange, and it’s here to ruin your Mercenary run...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a9faede84c91e2e6fba7bb9158bd4bbf21e288a4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

It’s Gup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e32bd1c6a4a097eacdb3c7c58dbca61f7c9568fc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

And Geep and Gip, obviously.

Don't forget this is just a sample of the new stages and monsters you’ll find in [b]Survivors of the Void [/b]- And that concludes the Petrichor Safari. As always thanks for being an amazing community and join me next year when we’ll have many more exciting reveals for you all.

Goodbye for now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/ce390449b963359f701da60ba6382aa331525877.gif[/img]

Jonathan @ Hopoo Games.

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/2f3536bf5e3ff8f71d2f95a7761c3506c1830b35.png[/img]

[h1]Dev Thoughts #23 - Survivors of the Void
[/h1]

Hello fellow Survivors! Welcome back!

[h1]Dev Thoughts Video[/h1]

I wanted to start out by thanking everyone who reached out to me following last month’s video version of the Dev thoughts - as requested I got a huge amount of feedback - which was overwhelmingly positive [b]so I went ahead and made another one for this month![/b] Check it out and once again please let me know what you think!

[previewyoutube=1EBxT0zwIVA;full]https://youtu.be/1EBxT0zwIVA[/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Survivors of the Void[/h1]

The official artwork and the name of the upcoming Risk of Rain 2 Expansion is now ready to be unveiled: 

[b]Survivors of the Void. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/5fb9a8a70b14e2723617a881497c462296ad2b57.png[/img]

We have also launched the[b] Survivors of the Void[/b] store page on Steam:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607890/Survivors_of_the_Void]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607890/Survivors_of_the_Void[/url]

I’d highly recommend both wishlisting the expansion and checking the store page regularly, there [i]might just[/i] be some additions over the coming weeks. Also stick around for the rest of the Dev Thoughts -[b] these are not the only Survivors of the Void reveals we have today...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Survivor’s Corner[/h1]

Here’s a new section I'd like to include in each new Dev Thoughts where I highlight something cool created by our fans! This month i’d like to show off this amazing creation from [url=https://twitter.com/TheFiddleCat/status/1448691319728185345?s=20]@TheFiddleCat[/url] on Twitter:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/495049c92519baf5ed2ef6c684afcba8bc019a17.png[/img]

[b]Go and show them some love![/b] If any of you have created or seen anything Hopoo Games related drop me an email at [b]jonathan@hopoogames.com[/b] or ping me on [url=https://twitter.com/hopoogames]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/riskofrain2]Discord[/url] and I might just include it in a future Dev Thoughts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]IRL Item Printer[/h1]

You’ll never guess what we installed in our new office this month: A genuine Item Printer from RoR2!

[b]Someone let Ben near the bloody thing and he decided to make a load of copies of his raincoat...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/33f3574c8f9d604a25c5ecf3fc21a163b56c8892.png[/img]

Great job Ben you [i]dingus[/i], [b]What are we supposed to do with all these coats??[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/7eeefec98138bd81b9690c96c8f959e6b9eef5df.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/fe2816f43c2e45734c622fff79c6c66ae1e239b4.png[/img]
[i]Ok all is forgiven[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]New Game Mode[/h1]

Revealed in Dev Thoughts #21 and teased last month is the [b]new game mode[/b] which will be available in [b]Survivors of the Void.[/b]

How long will you last within the [b]Simulacrum[/b]? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/b7949b5102121a2eb9828ea4c2bebb9c7424078c.png[/img]

The [b]Simulacrum[/b] is a wave-based arena mode set within a [b]Void simulation[/b]. It can be played both single and multiplayer and contains any artifacts you’ve unlocked ready for use.[b] It is an endless mode that can conclude only in your simulated demise. [/b]

My personal best attempt is wave 65 as Bandit, the office record is currently held by raincoat enthusiast [b]Ben[/b] at an [i]astounding[/i] wave 140 as Acrid. There is no shortage of testing ([i]a.k.a. trying to beat each other’s record[/i]) going in behind the scenes with this new mode. [b]We think you’ll have as much fun playing it as we have testing it![/b]

The [b]Void[/b] has recreated some of the iconic locations from Risk of Rain 2 to assess the threat of these dangerous places - the simulation is familiar yet somehow… [b]different.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/1b217005fa9c108ce284b7370fd553dc5205b0cd.png[/img]
[i]But definitely purple. [/i]

Within a confined safe-zone monsters spawn in waves of increasing difficulty and every 5th wave is a difficult Boss encounter. Some waves also have random mutators applied - [b]maybe a random artifact is activated for one round...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a9688a7e73621a1a55fe7f73642ef4b69a55a524.png[/img]
[i]...or maybe something that really sucks instead.[/i]

After each wave a [b]Void Potential[/b] is created for every player, allowing you to select between 3 items giving you a great deal of control over your power within the Simulacrum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/29a87d732e6515378549ebf12a4f1d02f43be426.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

Item Crates and other interactables spawn on the stage as normal - [b]but venturing outside of the safe zone to reach these can be a great risk.[/b] Thankfully after every boss wave the safe zone moves to a new area, giving you a brief opportunity to open more crates and increase your power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/bea4f8d3f436878f69acbd5aa5769926adf2f4a2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]
[i]Get back here ya pesky varmint![/i]

Getting those extra items will be a great help - when you experience a Void simulation of the most dangerous threats in the universe [b]you never know who or what might show up to challenge you.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Gotta Kill ‘em All?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/a5e5f42669dbb19cf4c11ffd1270a35fa273bb7b.png[/img]

[b]Please share your renditions of this mystery enemy[/b] in the #ror2-art-and-content channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/riskofrain2]Discord[/url] with a @SeventeenUncles ping plz. My personal favourite(s) will be included in next month’s Dev Thoughts.

[b]Much Love[/b]

Jonathan @ Hopoo Games

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/759858e9b5eb8d58c07f81670a4242bb0068c483.png[/img]

[h1]Dev Thoughts #22 - Delve Deeper[/h1]

Hey! I told you I'd be back this month!

[h1]Last month’s Dev Thoughts Reaction[/h1]

A huge thank you to everyone who reached out and let me know what you thought of last month’s Dev Thoughts,[b] we love how excited you are about the upcoming RoR2 expansion![/b] Due to the positive response I decided to try out a video version of this month’s Dev Thoughts:

[previewyoutube=7nQfQ1EDXys;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Please let me know what you think -[/b] especially if you would like to see this alternative format more in the future (I will continue with the written Dev Thoughts regardless.) Any ideas for future content/suggestions/critiques very welcome and greatly appreciated!

As always you can catch me on our Discord as [b]@SeventeenUncles[/b], or you can email me at [b]jonathan@hopoogames.com[/b]. Or whack a comment on that Youtube video, also I’m pretty sure you’re supposed to smash that like button while you’re there. [b]Smash it.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Movers and Shakers[/h1]

Before we get into the [i]meat 'n' potatoes[/i] of the Dev Thoughts, one new thing for us at Hopoo games is that we moved offices!

Who is this welcoming us into the reception?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/327163bc8e046d8113a1e945a4974bb57ec3ba27.jpg[/img]

[b]Why, its Ghor himself![/b] Everyone say [b]Hi[/b] to Ghor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/73852cde6c0c6154f8cd262de36ebb3dadab432a.jpg[/img]

[b]“Hi Gamers!”[/b] [i]- Ghor[/i] 

[b](someone call HR this guy isn’t wearing any damn pants)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Expansion FAQ[/h1]

Earlier this month I asked on Twitter what your #1 question about the expansion was and you didn't disappoint! [b]Never fear[/b] - I am here to dish out the answers to the most popular ones...

[h3]1 - What is the release date and will it launch on console at the same time?[/h3]

The Steam release is currently on-schedule for a Q1 2022 release window.[b] The console version will be released at a later date.[/b]

One of our more lofty goals when we first announced the expansion was our hope to do a simultaneous release on all platforms - this was something that we have not attempted before.

The deeper into development we go the more we realise that the only way to achieve this would have been to delay the release of the Steam version. [b]We didn’t like this one bit[/b] - so we have decided to go with the Steam release first with the console release coming soon afterwards.

We don’t want to pin a precise release window on the console version right now, [b]however we will get it in your hands as soon as possible.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/1de3634ce3357142ef25545a0c1ea112e09d29df.png[/img]
[i]Lofty goals.[/i]

[h3]2 - How will multiplayer work between people who own and don’t own the expansion?[/h3]

As long as [b]one player[/b] in the lobby owns the expansion you can enable expansion content such as new items, stages and monsters for that session - even if the other players in the lobby do not own the expansion. [b]However only people who own the expansion will be able to play as the new expansion-exclusive survivors.[/b]

We think that splitting the multiplayer community between the “haves” and “have-nots” is kind of a worst case scenario - we want everyone to enjoy the game and keep the community together (aww.)

[h3]3 - How much will the expansion cost?[/h3]

[b]The price of the expansion is still being discussed.[/b] We want to land on a price which represents the amount of new content in the expansion and is also excellent value for our players.

As soon as we have decided on the price we will announce it [b]ASAP.[/b]

[h3]4 - How can I protect Goobo Jr from this horrible world?[/h3]

Don’t worry, Goobo Jr can take care of itself quite nicely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/b76024a19652bcbc90df19c435c975d2a0624adf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Expansion REVEAL[/h1]

Last month I promised you more expansion teasers and I am here once again to [b]sneak the deets[/b] out of the coffers of the Hopoo dev team..

The theme of the upcoming Risk of Rain 2 Expansion is the [b]Void[/b]

The [i]eagle-eyed lore-hunters[/i] among you will have seen references to the [b]Void[/b] scattered throughout the current log-book entries. Well, you’re about to find out a whole lot more about this mysterious force - [b]Approximately a third of the new content is Void themed[/b] and that includes the new loot-tier I teased last month...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Void Items[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/3a57988dab2816d6823a69ba2492e0da62c0318e.gif[/img]

Awaiting your discovery in the expansion are [b]Void Items[/b]. These are sneaky doppelgangers of existing items - once collected they absorb all copies of the original item and corrupts them to increase their own power for the rest of the run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/af9b03558e1c8c09ae31e1f1016cf4cef336ccc3.gif[/img]

[b]Void Items[/b] have warped effects, similar but distinct to their non-void counterparts…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/875c927f74e09d8b1d6d2bb00a6ce832c17c56fe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/809ca2cfc7f15033cba3094177fdb9aeeaac5c5b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/50ee10e8eac209857ce7be25808b7d5849f3df71.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/e19cacacc51458949b0fb81060c9e96c7d513d3c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/8860abf6f6d5a2dd654f8db2e3183be7da5fae62.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/937197b3e82bb4948251e5786e4b62c8a81201ab.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]

[b]This is just a small sample of the many Void Items within the expansion.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]
[h1]
Until Next Time[/h1]

Once again thank you very much for being a great community and your continued support! Don’t forget to come back next month when maybe,[b] just maybe[/b], i’ll have even more expansion teasers for you all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6f4a1fb91f6fb0963038585d2d6aa45e5f14b0a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/dd0dc8d411192fc12a30090e149a69cf448820c3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/016363452cc55cea2ed0a85cb4a877c4145f27b5.png[/img]
[i]Literally me for another month.[/i]

Goodbye for now!

Jonathan @ Hopoo Games

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #21
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/21840ce4e1f11ea9b0726a1f3518d35d55bb13da.png[/img]

[h1]Dev Thoughts #21 - Where did 2021 go?[/h1]

Hi! It’s been a minute since we shared some of our Dev Thoughts - so let’s get right into it.

[h1]Introducing a New Team Member[/h1]

One thing we pride ourselves on at Hopoo Games is our relationship with our players. We love making the games you want to play, and hearing what you have to say about them. We thought the time was right to bring someone on board to make sure all voices, both in the community and the dev team, are heard. 

Introducing…me.

[h1]Jonathan Cheetham - Community Manager[/h1]

Hello everyone! My name is Jonathan and I am your new Community Manager for Hopoo Games. I am a long time fan of Hopoo Games as well as an occasional collaborator (I was a beta tester on DEADBOLT and an alpha tester on RoR2), and as you can imagine I was absolutely thrilled to join Hopoo Games in an official capacity. 

I will be your eyes, ears, mouth, and whatever other body parts you need in the development team, so no matter the feedback, let me know (especially you @plz_add_chef_to_ror2 guy.)

You can catch me on our [url=https://discord.gg/riskofrain2]Discord[/url] as [b]@SeventeenUncles[/b], or you can email me at [b]jonathan@hopoogames.com[/b]. Alternatively I will be active on all our official social media platforms ([url=https://twitter.com/RiskofRain]Twitter[/url]/[url=https://www.instagram.com/riskofraingame/]Instagram[/url]/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/632360/discussions/]Steam[/url]/[url=https://www.facebook.com/RiskofRainGame/]Facebook[/url]). However you’d like to chat, I'll be there. Watching. Waiting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28e5d52965df9279d7dccc90b2f08d97763641ea.png[/img]
[i]Nice.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Console Anniversary Update Patch[/h1]

The Risk of Rain 2 Anniversary Update is now available on all platforms including the Nintendo Switch as of August 17th, and on that same day we pushed a bug fix update to the PS4 & Xbox One versions of the game - so if you haven't played recently on console give it a try and let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/195f08690ffb5564f5e8ab68ef17cd4cb5ab719b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Risk of Rain 2 Expansion #1[/h1]

[b]We are now aiming for a Q1 2022 release window for the first Risk of Rain 2 Expansion.[/b]

In the last couple of Dev Thoughts we have told you about the first expansion to RoR2 that we have been working very hard on. We want to make this expansion the biggest & best content update for RoR2 so far, and in order to meet these goals we need a little more time than anticipated.

We know some of you may be bummed out with this updated timeline - however, I have faith that you will absolutely love what we have in store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/28edb2b6eadbebdd1f2ad899cfef59995e9acb07.png[/img]

[h1]Expansion Teaser[/h1]

In our original [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/632360/view/2927867089368726399]roadmap[/url] we told you what we hoped to include in the new expansion. Now that we’re deep into development we are excited to give you a better idea of what content you can actually expect. 

At this moment, we are planning on releasing with:

[list]
[b][*] Alternate Final Boss & Stage
[*] 2 New Survivors -[/b] Unique new survivors to give you a fresh way to experience the game

notes.title: Risk of Rain 2 gets a massive anniversary update, and a giant number of returning players
notes.content:
Risk of Rain 2 officially entered Early Access in March 2019, and while the game went 1.0 back in August 2020, it seems the devs aren't entirely through with their take on roguelike games. Risk of Rain 2 has just received a massive anniversary update with a new playable character, new enemies, and a complete rework to the final stage, and players are flocking back to it en masse.

Risk of Rain 2's anniversary update went live on March 25, and while you can get the full list of additions over on Steam, even just the highlights are impressive. The Bandit survivor returns, and there's a new monster, new elite, and new boss. The devs say "the final stage has been redone entirely, with unique objectives and a new, large arena to play in", too.

Players are here for it, too. Following the update, the peak player count for Risk of Rain 2 hit 55,800, up from a high of just 7,370 the day before, as SteamDB shows. That's by far the biggest number since the game's 1.0 launch last year.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Risk of Rain 2 celebrates second birthday with sizeable Anniversary Update on PC
notes.content:
March 2021 marks two years since Hopoo Games' enormously successful co-operative rogue-like shooter sequel Risk of Rain 2 first entered early access, and the developer is celebrating with the launch of a significant free update on PC.

Risk of Rain 2's Anniversary Update - which launches this Thursday, 25th March - is intended to "flesh out and round out the base game", revisiting old items and finishing up content that didn't make it into Hopoo's version 1.0 release.

For starters, it introduces a previously scrapped Survivor known as the Bandit (Hopoo notes the scrapped version, which has since been revived by modders, will continue to work alongside the new iteration), as well as an abandoned boss referred to as the Grandparent.

Read more

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #20 - 2 Years Later
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/724a5982dfb304e1b167984e87a444c5b6c35011.png[/img]

[h1]From Launch To Now[/h1]

As we prepare to launch the Anniversary Update - more on that below - we’ve also been looking back at our journey with Risk of Rain 2. On March 28, 2019, Paul swaggered onto stage at PAX East and we launched Risk of Rain 2 on Early Access - to wonderful reception from all our fans.

Since then, we have (yes this is about to be a huge flex)
[list]
[*] Sold over 4,000,000 copies on Steam alone
[*] Launched and grown to over 180,000 users in our official Discord
[*] Received ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ from over 137,000 Steam Reviews alongside an 85% on Metacritic
[*] Gained new community members with 88% of players playing for more than 1 hour - and 57% of players playing for more than 10, numbers we are extremely proud of
[/list]
So, yeah. We’ve grown a lot since Risk 1 and DEADBOLT.

We have also expanded our internal team, and hired new great talents to help work on RoR2 and future games to come. If you’re interested in joining, [url=https://hopoogames.com/jobs-at-hopoo-games/]we’re currently hiring[/url]! At the moment, we’re looking for a [url=https://hopoogames.com/jobs-at-hopoo-games/3d-animator/]3D Animator[/url] and a [url=https://hopoogames.com/jobs-at-hopoo-games/vfx-artist/]VFX Artist[/url]. Interested? Apply!

[h1]Anniversary Update[/h1]

We’re happy to announce that the free Anniversary Update (or Content Update March, as some of you have started to call it) will be launching on March 25th 2021. 

Our goal with this update is to really flesh out and round out the base game, and also be a ‘thanks!’ to all our fans that supported us through Early Access. A lot of the focus of this update is revisiting old items and finishing up content that didn’t make it into 1.0 release - we’ve added like 88 lore entries. Shoutouts to Sivelos for helping us do a ton of heavy lifting for these log entries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/14babd7a7f7a47cf7789636b9774a68bfeaad486.png[/img]

We’re also adding our newest survivor - [b]the Bandit[/b] - back into RoR2. Working on the Bandit was both fun and rewarding for us, because it really highlighted how much better we’ve gotten at making content since the original scrapped inception of the Bandit in internal development. Let us know how he feels! 

PS: We know that the scrapped Bandit has always been a favorite for modders to add their own finishes and ideas to - and so we have implemented our Bandit as a separate survivor from the modded Bandit, in order to preserve community-made Bandit mods. Enjoy both!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/fc0137f361df8321a35be7f5fcb0ad971e38dfe4.png[/img]

[h1]Expansion #1[/h1]

As we announced in our previous Dev Thoughts, we are planning on releasing a paid Expansion late (very late) this year. While we’ve admittedly been spending a majority of our focus for the Anniversary Update, we will internally be starting to shift towards working on the Expansion. As we develop and shape it over time, we will let players know how it’s going, and how big it will be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/c97c058f571c3af190bef1c88818105e4430ca95.jpg[/img]

[h1]Consoles[/h1]

Since our Early Access release, PlayEveryWare has done a fantastic job keeping up with the breakneck pace of development and ensuring that console players experience Risk of Rain 2 at the highest of quality (alongside taking advantage of specific features) on the PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.

We’re also glad to announce that we have a new, internal team at Gearbox that is focused on continuing to bring all future content of Risk of Rain 2 to our console players with even closer parity to our PC version of the game. 

While the Anniversary Update will be staggered from PC releases like before, [b]our goal with Expansion #1 is to ship on all platforms at the same time[/b]. We can’t guarantee 100% that we will achieve that - its something we’ve admittedly never done before - but that’s our goal.

[h1]Thank You[/h1]

As always, thanks everyone for being passionate for the games we make. We have a lot of exciting things cooking - both for Risk of Rain fans and Hopoo Games fans in general - and we can’t wait to share them with you - one day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/6d4ca331329b5ddc47803f5e32d034615aaf4c42.gif[/img]

[i]-Hopoo Games[/i]

notes.title: Dev Thoughts #19 - Risk of Rain 2 In 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/410fad390ae244e29ee36d1a303fc047cf804966.png[/img]

Hey!

Believe it or not - we’re still here, and we haven’t fled the country with all our earnings. At least, not yet.

All of us at Hopoo Games have been keeping ourselves very busy these past few months - and we’re excited to catch everyone up on what we’ve been doing.

[h1]Hopoo Games Expanding[/h1]

After the success of RoR2, we knew that we’d eventually expand Hopoo Games to better support RoR2 long term. During Early Access, we simply didn’t have the time or resources to find, hire, and onboard new members to our team.

Now that we hit 1.0 - and got a bit of a breather - we’re happy to announce that we have expanded the core Hopoo Games Team from 3 to 6.

[h2]Ben Schofield[/h2]

My name is Ben, and I’m here to say
I’m the newest programmer at Hopoo Ga... (mes)

In my eight years in the game industry, I've worked on pretty much everything, from UI to servers to tools, but my player-first mentality has kept my focus on gameplay.  I love gameplay programming so much that I spin up side projects in my spare time just to get more of it, so I'm thrilled to dedicate my time to gameplay for Risk of Rain 2.  Beyond that, I'm super excited to support this community.  There's nothing better than building a game for an enthusiastic audience, so I look forward to seeing your reactions to the stuff we're cooking up!

[h2]Nick Bizzozero[/h2]

Hiya, I’m super excited to join the team - I am a huge fan of Risk of Rain 2 myself.  A little about me:  I started my 3d career doing mods of Project M, and I also made Strafe!  Some of my favorite games include Quake, Team Fortress, Super Mario 64, and Super Smash Bros Melee.  My favorite things in games are slipping and sliding around and rocket jumping : )  I will be doing my best to keep Risk of Rain 2 an engaging and visually slick experience!  (╯ ͡❛ ⏥ ͡❛)╯┻━┻  💪( ͡❛ ⏥͡❛ ҂) <( 行くぞ! )

[h2]Javid “Snonepe”[/h2]

Greetings! I'm Javid (Jah-vid, if you were curious). Both Risk of Rain 1 and 2 are games I've highly enjoyed and I'm absolutely ecstatic at this opportunity to contribute to the future of Risk of Rain 2!

Previously, I worked at Airship Syndicate for a few years where I handled a wide variety of animations for Battle Chasers: Nightwar and some additional work on Darksiders: Genesis. Additionally, I've worked on a couple of Source Engine based projects such as the Civil Protection Machinima, the No More Room in Hell mod and workshop items for Team Fortress 2 such as the Box Trot taunt.

I grew up playing a lot of JRPGs, some of my favorites being Chrono Trigger, Final Fantasy 9 and the early Paper Mario games. When I'm not playing Risk of Rain 2, I can be found playing Final Fantasy 14, Slay the Spire or Team Fortress 2.

--

We’re excited to work with our newest members, and we hope that you’ll treat them as kindly as you have me, Paul, and Ghor :^)

[h1]2021 Roadmap[/h1]

As we leave 2020 (god finally) and enter into 2021, we wanted a way for fans to know how RoR2 was going to be supported going forward. 

So, more roadmaps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33906904/410fad390ae244e29ee36d1a303fc047cf804966.png[/img]

This roadmap is intentionally different from our Early Access Roadmap in both cadence and detail. As we explained in our last Dev Thoughts, we want players to know the game is still being supported, but we also don’t want to sacrifice our internal goals to hit the deadlines on a public roadmap. We’re keeping things flexible - so please note that the details may change over time.

[h1]Anniversary Update[/h1]

March 2021 marks the 2nd year anniversary since the release of Risk of Rain 2 in Early Access. To celebrate this milestone, we’re doing a free content update! 

This update is aimed towards [b]upgrading and rounding out the game as a whole[/b]. This means that the Anniversary Update will be smaller in content compared to other CUs. Internally, we’ve already made great progress towards lore entries, quality-of-life improvements, and other meaningful changes to existing RoR2 content. We’re also revisiting some assets - like the Grandparent boss, for example - that were cut during development.

We’re also keeping an eye on our ever growing modding community, and are making some internal changes (like moving away from fixed enum indices for content and more towards scriptable objects, investigating an engine upgrade) to work toward an easier and more sustainable modding environment for RoR2.

[h1]Expansion #1[/h1]

Near the end of 2021, we will also be releasing our first ever paid expansion. The hope for this expansion is that it’s big - we’re aiming at around 2-3 content updates in size, and it will easily be the biggest infusion of new content that RoR2 has received. We believe that we need a truly meaningful update to give RoR2 fans a reason to come back and support the game - and we’re sure that this expansion will hit that mark.

Doing an expansion of this size is new territory for us - and we’ll be keeping very busy - but we will still update players on our progress as we work on the expansion. While we still plan to ship the Anniversary Update on consoles at the same cadence as previous updates, we also have an internal goal of shipping Expansion #1 on all platforms at the same time - we’ll keep you up to date on that as well.

[h1]Thank You[/h1]

The continued enthusiasm and support from the community makes hiring an easy choice - and we are excited that we can match our growing community with a growing team. As always - thank you for making working on RoR2 fun. 

Catch you next year!
-Hopoo Games
